item.title: Founding Full-stack Engineer (TypeScript, Web3)
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Developer Jobs • Blockchain Full Stack Jobs • Blockchain Typescript Jobs • Cryptocurrency Remote Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs

Saifuro checks payments that AI agents try to make. An agent asks to spend, we compare the request with a mandate a human approved earlier, and the answer comes back signed so the receiving side can verify it. There's escrow on Base and Solana for trades between agents, and settlement is in USDC, onchain. We never hold customer funds. The docs are public at docs.saifuro.com, and the people who use them are developers building agents and the teams selling APIs to those agents.

You'd be one of our first engineers, and you'd lead the product customers log into: the console where a finance team watches its agents spend, the policy editor, the approvals, the sandbox. Founding means you shape what we build as well as how, and you have a say in who joins next. Call it product engineer, full-stack developer or Web3 developer if you prefer.

What you'd be doing

• Foundations. Decide how we build: architecture, testing, deployment and monitoring for the codebase every engineer after you will work in.

• Customers. Talk to the teams integrating Saifuro, see where they get stuck, and ship the fix the same week.

• Onchain. Bring USDC settlement, escrow status and receipts into the product, so every payment can be traced from approval to the chain.

• The product. Build what customers log into, from the database to the screen: what their agents spend, payments waiting for approval, and the record behind every decision.

What we need from you

• You've shipped TypeScript on both sides, a React front end and a Node back end, in a product people paid for.

• You've built against an EVM chain or Solana, with viem, ethers or something like them.

• You live in one of the countries we can hire in.

Beyond these requirements, we'll support you in learning whatever else the role demands. If your experience is relevant but your title differs, we would still like to hear from you. Work outside a job counts too: open source, hackathons and your own projects.

It helps, but isn't required, if you've built dashboards for payments or fintech, if you've worked with Postgres and event streams, if you know Go, if you've built with an agent framework or MCP, or if you've been one of the first engineers somewhere before.

Pay and benefits

• Salary $190,000 to $225,000. That's the US range. Outside the US we pay in USD, or in USDC if you'd rather, and set the offer against the top of the local market.

• Equity: 1.0% of Saifuro, vesting.

• Health: 100% of medical, dental and vision premiums for US employees, 75% for dependents. Outside the US, the local plan through our employer of record, or $300 a month toward private cover.

• 25 days of paid vacation plus your public holidays, and we close between Christmas and New Year.

• 14 weeks of paid parental leave, for any parent.

• A laptop and $1,000 toward your workspace.

• $1,500 a year for learning, conferences included. That's on top of the events you'll attend for work: six to eight a year, planned a quarter ahead, on the company.

Hours are flexible. The one thing we ask is to be online from 14:00 to 17:00 UTC, when the team overlaps for calls and quick questions. That's a window, not the working day. The rest of your hours are yours to arrange. A mainnet incident doesn't keep office hours. If that window is the middle of your night, say so and we'll work something out.

You can combine this with a job at another company, as long as the two don't conflict.

How to apply

Email with the subject "Founding Full-stack Engineer". Attach your resume and include links to your GitHub and LinkedIn profiles, as well as X or a personal site if you have them. Let us know your country of residence. We'll reply with the next steps.

Apply here 👉 Founding Full-stack Engineer (TypeScript, Web3)

item.title: Business Development & Partnerships Manager
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Manager Jobs • Blockchain Business Development Jobs • Web3 Remote Jobs • Web3 Full Time Jobs

Saifuro checks payments that AI agents try to make. An agent asks to spend, we compare the request with a mandate a human approved earlier, and the answer comes back signed so the receiving side can verify it. There's escrow on Base and Solana for trades between agents, and settlement is in USDC, onchain. We never hold customer funds. The docs are public at docs.saifuro.com, and the people who use them are developers building agents and the teams selling APIs to those agents.

Your job is to build the pipeline and turn it into paying customers and live partners on Base and Solana, which is where agent payments clear today. Call it sales if you prefer. A good part of it is.

What you'd be doing

• The pipeline. Teams running agents that spend, API providers selling to agents, agent marketplaces. You find them, run the sandbox demo yourself, scope the pilot in writing and close. All of it lives in a CRM with next steps, reviewed weekly.

• The ecosystems. Base and Coinbase Developer Platform, the Solana Foundation and Superteam, Circle, the x402 community. Directory listings, grants and programs, co-marketing, and a slot at their builder events.

• Integration partners. The wallets and custodians where agent keys stay, the agent frameworks (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, Vercel AI SDK, MCP) and the protocol teams. One joint guide and one joint announcement per partner, shipped with our developer relations engineer.

• The paperwork. Usage-based pricing applied the same way every time, pilot terms, MSAs, DPAs, security questionnaires, with the CFO. Finance teams buy payments infrastructure slowly, and you know the steps.

• The handover. Every signed deal gets a written brief for engineering and marketing, and a monthly check-in with the partner so nothing goes quiet after the signature.

What we need from you

Two things. Everything else can be learned here.

• You've closed deals in crypto, payments or developer tools.

• You live in one of the countries we can hire in.

It helps, but isn't required, if you've sold payments to finance and compliance teams as well as engineers, if you've won an ecosystem grant or a place in a program like Base Batches or a Solana Foundation cohort, if you know the agent-framework crowd, or if you've deployed something on Base or Solana yourself.

Pay and benefits

• Salary $105,000 to $145,000. That's the US range. Outside the US we pay in USD, or in USDC if you'd rather, and set the offer against the top of the local market.

• Equity: 0.15% of Saifuro, vesting.

• Health: 100% of medical, dental and vision premiums for US employees, 75% for dependents. Outside the US, the local plan through our employer of record, or $300 a month toward private cover.

• 25 days of paid vacation plus your public holidays, and we close between Christmas and New Year.

• 14 weeks of paid parental leave, for any parent.

• A laptop and $1,000 toward your workspace.

• $1,500 a year for learning, conferences included. That's on top of the events you'll attend for work: six to eight a year, planned a quarter ahead, on the company.

Hours are flexible. The one thing we ask is to be online from 14:00 to 17:00 UTC, when the team overlaps for calls and quick questions. That's a window, not the working day. The rest of your hours are yours to arrange, and partner calls will land in other people's time zones anyway. If that window is the middle of your night, say so and we'll work something out.

You can combine this with a job at another company, as long as the two don't conflict. For this role that means no other company selling to the same customers.

How to apply

Email with the subject "Business Development & Partnerships Manager". Attach your resume and include a link to your LinkedIn profile and, if you have them, your X or Telegram. Let us know your country of residence. We'll reply with the next steps.

item.title: Smart Contract Engineer (Rust, Solana)
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Cryptocurrency Developer Jobs • Cryptocurrency Smart Contract Jobs • Cryptocurrency Rust Jobs • Blockchain Remote Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs

Saifuro checks payments that AI agents try to make. An agent asks to spend, we compare the request with a mandate a human approved earlier, and the answer comes back signed so the receiving side can verify it. There's escrow on Base and Solana for trades between agents, and settlement is in USDC, onchain. We never hold customer funds. The docs are public at docs.saifuro.com, and the people who use them are developers building agents and the teams selling APIs to those agents.

The escrow is the one place where our code holds other people's money. USDC goes in, waits until a signed verdict says the deal is done, and comes out to the seller or back to the buyer, with no path in which Saifuro can move it. On Solana that's an Anchor program, and it would be yours: the program, the check on our signatures, the audits and the releases. Call it Solana developer, smart contract developer or Rust developer if you prefer. It's Rust.

What you'd be doing

• The escrow program. USDC held in a vault the program owns, released only against a signed verdict, refunded without us when a deal falls through. Design, code and tests are yours.

• The verifier. The program checks our signed verdict before anything moves. You own that check onchain.

• Audits and releases. An external audit before every mainnet upgrade, the findings answered in the open, and an upgrade authority an auditor is comfortable with.

• Parity with Base. A deal behaves the same way on both chains. You and the engineer on the Solidity side agree the spec, and the tests prove it.

What we need from you

• You've written Solana programs. Anchor or native, either is fine.

• You live in one of the countries we can hire in.

Beyond these requirements, we'll support you in learning whatever else the role demands. If your experience is relevant but your title differs, we would still like to hear from you. Work outside a job counts too: open source, hackathons and your own projects.

It helps, but isn't required, if you know how a program gets drained when a signer or owner check is missing, if you've written Solidity, if you know the SPL Token and Token-2022 programs, if you've worked with USDC on Solana or Circle's CCTP, if you've found bugs for a bounty or done security research, or if your work is open source.

Pay and benefits

• Salary $170,000 to $220,000. That's the US range. Outside the US we pay in USD, or in USDC if you'd rather, and set the offer against the top of the local market.

• Equity: 0.30% of Saifuro, vesting.

• Health: 100% of medical, dental and vision premiums for US employees, 75% for dependents.

Outside the US, the local plan through our employer of record, or $300 a month toward private cover.

• 25 days of paid vacation plus your public holidays, and we close between Christmas and New Year.

• 14 weeks of paid parental leave, for any parent.

• A laptop and $1,000 toward your workspace.

• $1,500 a year for learning, conferences included. That's on top of the events you'll attend for work: six to eight a year, planned a quarter ahead, on the company.

Hours are flexible. The one thing we ask is to be online from 14:00 to 17:00 UTC, when the team overlaps for calls and quick questions. That's a window, not the working day. The rest of your hours are yours to arrange. A mainnet incident doesn't keep office hours. If that window is the middle of your night, say so and we'll work something out.

You can combine this with a job at another company, as long as the two don't conflict and nothing you'd write there touches our programs or competes with them.

How to apply

Email with the subject "Smart Contract Engineer (Solana)". Attach your resume and include links to your GitHub and LinkedIn profiles, as well as X or a personal site if you have them. Let us know your country of residence. We'll reply with the next steps.

Apply here 👉 Smart Contract Engineer (Rust, Solana)

item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Product Manager Jobs • Web3 Senior Jobs • Web3 Bitcoin Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs

Blockstream was founded in 2014 by Dr. Adam Back and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the future of finance. Focusing on building fundamental Bitcoin infrastructure, Blockstream quickly grew into one of the leading technology power houses of the industry.

First announced at the Bitcoin 2025 conference in Las Vegas in May, Blockstream Enterprise is a Bitcoin-focused software suite enabling banks, prime brokers and corporations to safely and securely custody Bitcoin and manage tokenization and treasury operations.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to join our Enterprise product team to lead the ongoing development and adoption of our Enterprise solution.

What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities):

70% – Technical Product Management

  • Translate vision into actionable roadmap, own the product narrative and communicate effectively to all levels of the organization

  • Engage with engineering in technical conversations, understanding implications of technical decisions, and align Engineering work to product goals

  • Lead project execution, anticipating and resolving roadblocks, coordinating the work of teammates, and clearly communicating goals and status with the organization

  • Identify product opportunities, translating them into clear milestones and artefacts that align with Business Objectives

30% – Discovery & Research

  • Support Continuous Discovery habits, engage in market and customer research, follow regulatory/market news, identify trends

  • Conduct customer discovery workshops, document findings, translate insights into signals and identify gaps in the product roadmap

  • Drive product requirements, drive product documentation and own the workstream, collaborating with Engineering, Design, Business and Marketing teams

  • Gather qualitative and quantitative data to be able to support or challenge product assumptions/feature requests

What We Look For In You (Required Qualifications):

  • 7+ years of experience as a Product Manager in a regulated environment with a proven track record of delivering impact

  • Understanding of blockchain-based technology, crypto custody best practices, and the tokenization lifecycle

  • Exceptional communication skills and aptitude for conveying complex technical concepts

  • Comfort with the pace, scrappiness and dynamic environment within a growing startup.

  • Currently residing in the Zurich, Switzerland

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Nice To Haves (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Prior work experience on Bitcoin-related products

  • Experience with other enterprise-focused crypto products and their application / adoption among businesses from the TradFi sector

  • Deep understanding of traditional financial systems, services & products

  • A holistic understanding of the major interoperable cash generating units within global money center banks: Commercial banking, investment banking, prime brokerage and asset management

  • Prior knowledge of Liquid and its role in the Bitcoin ecosystem

🔒 Stay Safe from Job ScamsAll official Blockstream communication will come from an @blockstream.com email address. We will never ask you to share sensitive information or purchase equipment during the hiring process. If in doubt, contact us at Learn more about avoiding job scams here.

item.title: VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Community Manager Jobs • Web3 Sales Jobs • Cryptocurrency Senior Jobs • Web3 Remote Jobs • Web3 Full Time Jobs • Web3 Web3 Jobs

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Our VIP team supports the firm's highest-value private clients across the Payward ecosystem: high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) who expect a premium, secure, and highly tailored experience. We ensure Kraken remains the platform of choice for VIPs by delivering white-glove relationship management, personalized trading enablement, and high-impact benefits.

We are looking for a Senior VIP Relationship Manager, LATAM to help us scale our VIP client book and growth across the region. This is a hybrid role: part white-glove relationship management, part growth and business development. You'll build Kraken's presence inside LATAM's VIP trading and investor communities, run local marketing and events, and source new whale relationships.

We're looking for someone who isn't afraid to be bold, can build and scale initiatives from the ground up, and is humble enough to fail fast and move on to the next challenge. If you thrive in ambiguity and can operate in a fast-paced, scrappy environment, this role is for you.

The opportunity

  • Serve as the trusted point of contact for Kraken and Payward’s top private clients across LATAM, delivering consistent, high-quality white-glove service and building deep, durable relationships.

  • Own the regional VIP book end to end: onboarding, tier progression, retention, and proactive intervention on at-risk and lapsing clients.

  • Build lasting relationships that grow AOP, net deposits, and trading volume, your primary KPIs, by becoming the partner clients trust with more of their capital and activity over time.

  • Bring Kraken's private client and VIP offerings to market locally, including yield and earn campaigns, lending against tokenized equities and crypto collateral, OTC execution, and structured private-client benefits, ensuring they remain impactful and competitive against regional exchanges and desks.

  • Source and convert new HNWI relationships through direct outreach, referrals, and introducer networks, from crypto-wealthy individuals and family offices to the principals of trading firms, OTC desks, miners, and project treasuries.

  • Get inside LATAM's VIP trading communities: private trading groups, investor clubs, KOL and trader networks, and closed-door investor groups. Be the Kraken face those communities know and trust.

  • Design and run local marketing and events (VIP dinners, trader meetups, conference-adjacent programming, and co-marketing with regional partners and KOLs) in partnership with our Marketing and Regional teams.

  • Build and manage introducer and referral partnerships that produce a repeatable pipeline of qualified private clients.

  • Act as Payward’s ear on the ground: competitive intelligence on regional exchanges, product gaps that cost us whale business, and the local narratives that move capital.

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Compliance, Banking, and Client Service to champion new efforts that drive private client growth and loyalty, and to make sure every play you run is inside Kraken's licensing and compliance perimeter.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in relationship management, account management, private banking, brokerage, or private client sales, including at least 2 years in the crypto space, with a track record of working with HNWIs.

  • An existing, personal network among LATAM's crypto HNWIs, traders, family offices, OTC desks, funds, or trading communities in Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, or Chile.

  • Demonstrated ability to originate business, not just service it. You have personally brought in clients, run events, or built a community presence that produced measurable pipeline.

  • Deep understanding of trading product solutions, including spot, margin, and futures trading, as well as OTC trading, lending, and yield/earn products. Familiarity with how deposits and client balances drive an exchange's lending economics is a strong plus.

  • Comfort operating in a regulated environment across multiple LATAM jurisdictions, and the judgment to know when to involve Compliance early.

  • Highly data-driven, with expertise in analyzing KPIs such as assets on platform, net deposits, trading volume, and client portfolio revenue.

  • Ability to be scrappy, bold, and unafraid to explore alternative and creative solutions to achieve results.

  • Deep knowledge of cryptocurrency ecosystems, their players, frameworks, and market dynamics beyond just blue-chip tokens, including how local on/off-ramps and stablecoin flows shape client behavior in the region.

  • Skilled at building meaningful partnerships with internal and external stakeholders at all levels and across diverse backgrounds.

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% across the region for client meetings, events, and conferences.

  • Based in Brazil and native or near-native Portuguese plus fluent English required. Spanish is a strong plus.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

item.title: Senior Software Engineer, Developer Platform
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Senior Jobs • Web3 Javascript Jobs • Web3 Typescript Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs • Web3 Web3 Jobs

About MoonPay

MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. Recent recognition:

Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years runningResearch has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.

About the Opportunity

MoonPay is building a developer platform that allows partners to create native payment and crypto experiences directly inside their own products.

Historically, partners integrated MoonPay through a hosted widget and redirected users into a fixed MoonPay journey. We are now breaking the underlying system into reusable modules covering authentication, identity, KYC, quotes, payment methods and purchasing.

These capabilities are exposed through APIs, SDKs, embedded components, iframes and web views. Our goal is for a partner developer to integrate MoonPay’s full capabilities without needing ongoing implementation support from our team.

This role owns the developer-facing layer between MoonPay’s underlying payments infrastructure and the products our partners build. You will work across browsers, mobile applications and backend APIs to make complex financial workflows feel simple, predictable and native.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will build the platform itself rather than implementing one-off integrations for individual customers.

Build the developer platform

  • Design and build APIs, SDKs and embedded components used by external developers.

  • Turn MoonPay’s existing authentication, identity, payment and purchasing capabilities into reusable platform modules.

  • Develop secure browser and mobile integration patterns across iframes, web views and native applications.

  • Create stable abstractions over complex payments, compliance and crypto infrastructure.

  • Build reference applications, sandboxes and tooling that help developers move quickly from exploration to production.

Understand the integration deeply

  • Own the complete developer journey, from obtaining credentials through to completing a live transaction.

  • Design clear interfaces for sessions, authentication, quotes, payment methods, transaction state and errors.

  • Handle the realities of browser and mobile environments, including cross-origin communication, redirects, storage restrictions and application lifecycle events.

  • Develop consistent behaviour across web, iOS and Android integrations.

  • Ensure integrations remain secure when operating inside products MoonPay does not control.

Make complex systems easy to use

  • Design APIs and SDKs that are difficult to misuse and straightforward to debug.

  • Establish clear versioning, compatibility and migration strategies.

  • Build documentation around how developers actually use the platform rather than treating it as a secondary deliverable.

  • Create useful errors, logs and observability so partners can resolve issues without contacting MoonPay.

  • Reduce integration time and the amount of direct support required from engineering.

Operate payment-critical software

  • Build systems where failures can prevent a customer from completing a purchase or leave a partner uncertain about transaction state.

  • Design for retries, duplicate events, delayed responses and dependencies failing in unexpected ways.

  • Implement idempotency, state recovery and graceful degradation across distributed payment flows.

  • Measure API and SDK adoption, integration success, reliability and developer experience.

  • Safely evolve the platform as MoonPay adds products, payment methods, regions and partners.

About You

Must-have experience and skills

  • External developer products. You have built APIs, SDKs, embedded components or integration tooling used by third-party developers.

  • Browser or mobile depth. You understand how browsers and mobile applications behave beneath the framework level, including sessions, storage, cross-origin communication and embedded experiences.

  • JavaScript and TypeScript. You have strong language fundamentals and have built production client-side or SDK infrastructure.

  • API and SDK design. You understand versioning, backwards compatibility, documentation, error design and safe migrations.

  • Distributed systems. You build correctly when events arrive twice, late or out of order and when dependencies fail.

  • Product judgement. You can turn complex platform capabilities into interfaces that developers can understand and adopt.

  • Ownership. You have taken developer-facing software from design through launch, adoption and ongoing production support.

Nice-to-have experience

  • Built payment APIs, checkout SDKs, embedded financial products or payment-method integrations.

  • Built products similar to Stripe Elements, Stripe.js, Plaid Link or Braintree’s client SDKs.

  • Experience with secure iframes, web views, postMessage or cross-origin browser infrastructure.

  • Developed SDKs across web, iOS or Android.

item.title: Smart Contract Engineer (Solidity, EVM)
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Cryptocurrency Developer Jobs • Cryptocurrency Solidity Jobs • Blockchain Smart Contract Jobs • Web3 Remote Jobs • Cryptocurrency Full Time Jobs

Saifuro checks payments that AI agents try to make. An agent asks to spend, we compare the request with a mandate a human approved earlier, and the answer comes back signed so the receiving side can verify it. There's escrow on Base and Solana for trades between agents, and settlement is in USDC, onchain. We never hold customer funds. The docs are public at docs.saifuro.com, and the people who use them are developers building agents and the teams selling APIs to those agents.

The escrow is the one place where our code holds other people's money. Funds go in, sit until a signed verdict says the deal is done, and come out to the seller or back to the buyer, with no path in which Saifuro can move them. Your job is to own the EVM side: the escrow, the verifier that checks our signatures onchain, the audits and the deployments. Call it Solidity developer, smart contract developer or blockchain developer if you prefer. It's Solidity first.

What you'd be doing

• The escrow. One contract system on Base: funds held until a signed verdict releases them, refunds that work without us, and no path in which Saifuro can move a counterparty's money. Design, code and tests are yours.

• The verifier. The contracts check our signature, the audience and the expiry before anything moves. You own that path onchain. The CTO runs the signing side and reviews your code.

• Audits and releases. An external audit before every mainnet release. You scope it, answer the findings and ship, with deployment scripts, a pause switch and a recovery runbook alongside.

• What comes next, at your pace. Milestone and multi-party escrow next year, and the same contracts on more EVM chains. None of it is a day-one requirement.

What we need from you

• You've shipped Solidity to mainnet.

• You live in one of the countries we can hire in.

Beyond these requirements, we'll support you in learning whatever else the role demands. If your experience is relevant but your title differs, we would still like to hear from you. Work outside a job counts too: open source, hackathons and your own projects.

It helps, but isn't required, if you know storage layout, reentrancy and signature verification at the EVM level, if you've written Rust or Anchor programs on Solana, if you've worked with account abstraction (ERC-4337) or session keys for agents, if you know Circle's USDC contracts and CCTP, if you've found bugs for a bounty or done security research, or if your work is open source.

Pay and benefits

• Salary $170,000 to $220,000. That's the US range. Outside the US we pay in USD, or in USDC if you'd rather, and set the offer against the top of the local market.

• Equity: 0.30% of Saifuro, vesting.

• Health: 100% of medical, dental and vision premiums for US employees, 75% for dependents.

Outside the US, the local plan through our employer of record, or $300 a month toward private cover.

• 25 days of paid vacation plus your public holidays, and we close between Christmas and New Year.

• 14 weeks of paid parental leave, for any parent.

• A laptop and $1,000 toward your workspace.

• $1,500 a year for learning, conferences included. That's on top of the events you'll attend for work: six to eight a year, planned a quarter ahead, on the company.

Hours are flexible. The one thing we ask is to be online from 14:00 to 17:00 UTC, when the team overlaps for calls and quick questions. That's a window, not the working day. The rest of your hours are yours to arrange. A mainnet incident doesn't keep office hours. If that window is the middle of your night, say so and we'll work something out.

You can combine this with a job at another company, as long as the two don't conflict and nothing you'd write there touches our contracts or competes with them.

How to apply

Email with the subject "Smart Contract Engineer (EVM)". Attach your resume and include links to your GitHub and LinkedIn profiles, as well as X or a personal site if you have them. Let us know your country of residence. We'll reply with the next steps.

Apply here 👉 Smart Contract Engineer (Solidity, EVM)

About OG.com

OG.com is a fast-growing, CFTC-regulated Prediction Market platform powered by cutting-edge technology. We’re building an engaging marketplace where users trade on real-world outcomes - from major sports and elections to cultural and financial events. With a sleek mobile-first app and a passionate community, we’re redefining how people interact with news, probabilities, and financial markets. OG.com runs on the rails of North American Derivatives Exchange, Inc. (NADEX), a CFTC-regulated exchange operating since 2004 and was acquired by Crypto.com in 2022.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to help shape the next generation of consumer prediction-market experiences at OG. You’ll design intuitive, trustworthy journeys that enable people to discover, understand, and participate in predictions across sports, finance, politics, culture, and entertainment.

Working closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and other cross-functional partners, you’ll take complex problems from discovery through launch. You’ll turn user insights and product data into clear design decisions, develop flows and prototypes, and help create experiences that balance simplicity, engagement, and transparency.

This role is ideal for a hands-on designer who enjoys working across the full product lifecycle, managing multiple priorities, and solving challenging UX problems in a fast-moving environment. You’ll contribute to a shared design system, influence product direction through your design work, and help establish a high bar for consumer experiences where trust, speed, and clarity are essential.

What You'll Actually Do:

  • Own design strategy end-to-end. You set the design principles and standards for each product alongside product and market requirements. You make the craft call. Nothing ships without meeting your bar.
  • Ship journeys, not screens. You define customer journeys and solve complex UX problems with urgency - from discovery through prototype to production - in lockstep with product and engineering.
  • Drive product strategy through design. You present design direction, decisions, and rationale to senior stakeholders. You don't decorate a roadmap; you shape it.
  • Own the design system. You oversee and contribute to the shared system so quality scales across teams instead of fragmenting into one-off UI.
  • Turn data and research into decisions. You dig into user behavior, run interviews, focus groups, and usability tests, and turn insights into roadmap-changing recommendations - not slide decks that die in a folder.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years professional experience working as a Product Designer.
  • Proven B2C product design experience. You have owned design for digital consumer products at meaningful scale and can walk through a launch where you set the craft bar, navigated stakeholder conflict, and shipped.
  • Portfolio that proves end-to-end ownership. You can show journeys you owned - not just polished screens -including the problem, the tradeoffs, and what moved after ship. A portfolio is required to be considered.
  • User-centered craft with business teeth. You apply UX principles in service of outcomes. You can describe a time you chose the harder UX path because the data (or the user behavior) demanded it - and what the number did.
  • Multi-project shipping at scale. You have run several workstreams in parallel and can point to how you sequenced, cut scope, and still shipped quality.
  • Executive presence. You translate creative vision into business language. You have aligned senior stakeholders on a design direction when opinions conflicted, and you can recount the decision and the aftermath.

Nice to have:

  • Prediction, Fintech, Crypto, or Trading UX: Proven track record designing money-moving or high-stakes financial flows where trust, risk visibility, and clarity are core to the product.
  • AI-Assisted Design & Prototyping: Hands-on experience using AI productively in your design workflow, including AI-powered exploration and prototyping with Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools.
  • Technical and Engineering Fluency: Familiarity with front-end development concepts, coding, GitHub, and technologies such as React - or demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with engineering teams and work effectively within technical constraints.
  • Design Systems at Scale: Experience evolving and maintaining design systems across multiple product squads, with demonstrable adoption beyond standard Figma libraries.
  • Research Ops Fluency: Ability to establish lightweight, repeatable research cadences that product and engineering teams actively utilize.

Why this role:

  • Own meaningful product experiences: Take complex user journeys from discovery and research through flows, prototypes, launch, and iteration - and see your work directly influence the customer experience.
  • Design for trust and clarity: Solve the unique challenge of making real-time, data-rich, and potentially money-related experiences feel intuitive, transparent, and accessible.
  • Work closely with decision-makers: Partner with Product, Engineering, Research, and senior design leaders to turn user insight into product direction and shipped experiences.
  • Grow your craft at scale: Contribute to a shared design system, work across multiple product challenges, and develop your ability to balance user needs, business outcomes, and technical constraints.
  • Join at an important moment: OG is building its U.S. product foundation now, giving you the opportunity to make a visible impact as the experience and design practice evolve.

item.title: Senior Product Manager - Fiat Onboarding, OG

About Us

OG is a Crypto.com company building a new prediction market experience — where it pays to be right. We combine the accessibility of a consumer app, the engagement of a social layer, and the rigor of an institutional-grade platform so fans and consumers can trade on real-world outcomes: sports, finance, politics, culture, and entertainment.

Headquartered in the U.S. and focused on the U.S. market first (with global expansion ahead), OG is backed by Crypto.com’s security and compliance infrastructure. Crypto.com’s vision remains simple: Cryptocurrency in Every Wallet™ — and OG is how we bring that product craft into prediction markets.

Role Overview
  • We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own how money and identity get into OG -signup, KYC, fiat funding, payouts, and the payments/banking product behind them. Fans don’t trade until they can fund. Every drop-off in onboarding or fiat costs volume, trust, and share of wallet.
  • Your mandate is to make funded accounts fast, trustworthy, and design-obsessive: the path from signup → KYC/fiat → ready to trade, the rails and payment methods that actually clear, the failure states that kill conversion, and the feedback loops that move the funnel. Trading surfaces (markets, parlays, live) sit with a partner PM. You own the front door.
  • You will run this roadmap with independence. You make the call on friction vs. compliance, which funding methods ship, and what waits when the UX or ops bar isn’t there. You report to the Chief Product Officer, who sets product strategy and priorities across OG. You own the how and the when.
  • If you’ve shipped consumer onboarding, fiat, payments, or banking products before, this will feel familiar. The difference is you’ll be doing it as the on-ramp into regulated U.S. prediction markets -where accessibility and bank-grade compliance collide, and the playbook for “best funded-user experience in the category” is yours to write.

What You'll Actually Do:

  • Own onboarding and fiat end-to-end. You are the DRI for signup, verify, deposit, and time-to-funded. You make the friction vs. compliance call. Ownership isn’t shipping a KYC screen; it’s moving signup → funded → ready for first trade.
  • Own the payments and banking product. You decide funding methods, payouts, limits, retries, and partner UX (ACH, cards, instant funding, and whatever clears in the U.S.). You treat rails, authorization, and flow of funds as product -not a vendor ticket.
  • Own the money-in funnel as a growth surface. You instrument drop-off, attack the leaks, and sequence work against conversion -not a feature list. You partner with the Predictions PM on the handoff from funded → first contract.
  • Hold the design bar on trust and money UX. You champion clarity, hierarchy, and error states as non-negotiable. You push back on “good enough” when users are putting in a debit card or waiting on an ACH. Specific feedback: interaction cost, copy, recovery -not vibes.
  • Wireframe and partner in Figma. You create your own wires and drive design conversations. You catch clunky funding and KYC interactions before users do.
  • Talk to users like a peer. You run research on how people currently sign up, verify, and move money. You ask “Show me how you fund this account,” not “Would you use instant deposit?” You distinguish what users say from what the funnel reveals.
  • Drive cross-functional execution. You align engineering, design, data, compliance, payments, banking partners, and ops around funded-user outcomes. You own the backlog and the ship cadence for this charter. Nothing in onboarding/fiat goes live without your sign-off on product and UX bar.

Requirements:

  • Fiat and onboarding ownership. You have owned money-in and/or user onboarding (signup, KYC/identity, deposits, funding) and can walk the funnel you owned, the drop-offs you attacked, and the number that moved.
  • Payments / banking product, not adjacent fintech. You have owned payment rails, funding methods, or banking/on-ramp product (ACH, cards, PSP, payouts, crypto on/off-ramp, or similar) and can point to a flow of funds, a partner integration, or a failure mode you actually ran. Résumé logos without rails ownership don’t clear the bar.
  • Design sensibility as a product skill. You can evaluate money-in and identity UX with specifics (hierarchy, density, recovery, trust), not “it looks nicer.” You can point to a flow you refused to ship until it was clear.
  • Data ownership. You instrument your own funnel, size the opportunity, and prioritize without waiting for someone to hand you the analysis.
  • User empathy in the product. You are willing to use OG regularly (onboard, fund, withdraw) to feel friction firsthand. You ask behavioral questions before feature questions.
  • We care what you’ve built and owned -not MBA, pedigree, or a certain number of years.

Preferred:

  • Crypto exchange, crypto bank, or regulated on/off-ramp PM work: you’ve already sat in compliance + rails + consumer conversion at once.
  • Consumer growth / activation: you’ve owned a signup or first-value funnel, not only the bank core.
  • Hands-on OG / prediction-market / sportsbook use: you know why funding has to feel instant for a live game.
  • Deep Figma / design-system fluency: you move faster with design as a peer, not a handoff.
  • AI player and pilot: you use AI tools with human-in-the-loop judgment to move faster on research, specs, and iteration.

Why This Role:

  • Direct volume impact. Onboarding and fiat are where prediction markets win or lose share of wallet. Your craft bar shows up in funded users -the input every trade depends on.
  • Frontier. Regulated U.S. prediction markets still don’t have a default “money in” experience. Consumer speed and bank-grade compliance at once -the rails are new and the playbook is yours to write.
  • Access. You work directly with product leadership. Your UX and prioritization calls land where strategy is set. No layers. No politics.
  • Leverage. Signup → funded is the front door of OG -not a side feature.
  • Upside. Early ownership of the payments/onboarding charter on a standalone prediction brand backed by Crypto.com’s compliance and scale infrastructure.
  • Team. High-calibre product, design, payments, and engineering partners who care whether the thing actually funds -not just whether it shipped.

item.title: Staff Data Scientist, Growth
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Data Jobs • Blockchain Senior Jobs • Cryptocurrency Full Time Jobs • Cryptocurrency Remote Jobs • Blockchain Bitcoin Jobs • Blockchain Web3 Jobs

At Shakepay, we’re on a mission to usher in the Bitcoin golden age. We’re reimagining financial services to give every Canadian their fair shake.Our culture is built around doing work that matters, winning as a team, and celebrating success. If you're the kind of person who values growth, shipping fast, and sharing your ideas openly with a group of like-minded people, come and build with us!

About Shakepay

Since 2015, we've been on a mission to help Canadians build long-term wealth through bitcoin. Over the past few years, we've expanded beyond buying and selling bitcoin to offer a growing suite of everyday financial products - including the Shakepay Card, direct deposit, bill payments and Interac e-Transfer - making it easier to earn, save and use bitcoin every day. Today, more than 1.5 million Canadians use Shakepay to grow their bitcoin savings and take control of their financial future as we continue to push the boundaries of what modern financial services can look like.

We’re regulated as an investment dealer across all Canadian provinces and territories, and backed by renowned venture capitalists with a funding of $44M. We have a passionate, loyal, and growing community, and we’re looking for people who want to help us build something truly special.

Staff Data Scientist, Growth

We’re looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join one of our cross-functional squads at Shakepay. You’ll work closely with engineering and design, while also partnering across marketing, finance, and operations to help us identify growth opportunities and make smarter decisions across the business.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, enjoys operating with high autonomy, and can turn ambiguous problems into measurable impact. You’ll combine experimentation, statistical rigor, business intuition, and product thinking to influence how we grow, retain, and better serve millions of Canadians.

What you’ll be doing

  • Partner closely with engineers and designers across our product squads to improve acquisition, activation, retention, monetization, and customer experience
  • Collaborate with marketing, finance, and operations teams to uncover growth opportunities and drive better business decisions
  • Champion and evangelize experimentation and decision frameworks that  help us ship and iterate quickly with confidence
  • Define KPIs and success metrics that  help teams stay aligned around measurable outcomes
  • Use statistical analysis, forecasting, causal inference, and machine learning techniques to better understand user behavior and business performance
  • Identify high-leverage opportunities proactively through deep analysis of user journeys, lifecycle behavior, conversion funnels, and financial performance
  • Help shape squad and company priorities by bringing data-informed perspectives on impact, tradeoffs, and ROI
  • Build dashboards, models, and self-serve tools that improve visibility into growth and business performance across the organization
  • Collaborate with the broader data team to maintain a shared and consistent data layer that serves our stakeholders and internal agents
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, curiosity, and evidence-based decision-making across Shakepay

Who we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of experience in data science, growth analytics, experimentation, or related roles in high-growth environments
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Deep understanding of experimentation, causal inference, statistical analysis, forecasting, and KPI design
  • Strong product and business intuition, with the ability to connect user behavior to company outcomes
  • Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as marketing, finance, operations, or product
  • Comfortable operating autonomously and driving ambiguous projects from idea to execution
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to influence decisions through data and clear reasoning
  • A demonstrated ability to manage and deliver on multiple projects with high attention to detail
  • Curiosity, speed, and a bias toward action in fast-moving environments
  • Solid understanding of dashboarding and data visualization tools
  • Willingness to learn and grow in a fast-paced environment

Bonus points

  • Experience in startup or high-growth consumer environments
  • Experience with experimentation and product analytics platforms such as Posthog, Statsig, Amplitude
  • Experience working with dbt, Snowflake, and modern data stacks
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing, customer segmentation, or growth modeling
  • Existing Shakepay customer and/or familiarity with the product
  • Interest and enthusiasm for the possibilities enabled by Bitcoin and non-sovereign money

Why join us?

  • Help shape the future of money: Be part of a team that's revolutionizing financial services in Canada, one sat at a time.
  • Impact millions: As cryptocurrency continues to gain traction, our potential for growth is massive. You can help us bring Shakepay and Bitcoin to all Canadians.
  • Grow your career: We’re growing, and so can you! We have programs in place to encourage continuous learning, growth, and development.
  • Ideas, not titles: We want the best ideas to make their way through, no matter where they come from.

Perks and benefits

  • 🤝 Be an owner - Every employee has stock options as part of their total compensation 
  • 🥅 Reach your goals - Yearly salary assessments 
  • 🦷 Health & wellness :  Access to comprehensive health and dental coverage, including health and wellness spending accounts. 
  • 🌎 Remote-friendly: Work from anywhere in Canada, with optional access to our office spaces in Montreal and Toronto.
  • 🆙 Level Up: A $2,000 annual budget for courses, certifications, and training to support your career growth.
  • 🌴 Time off: 20 days of vacation per year. And if you use all your vacation, we give you a $1,000 bonus.
  • 🐣 Parental leave: Enjoy a parental leave top up to 100% of your salary for 18 weeks.
  • 🙌 Have fun together: quarterly team-specific or company-wide offsite to connect with each other  

The base salary range for this position is $200,000 - $250,000 CAD. Base pay may vary based on factors such as years of experience, skills and qualifications. Additionally, employees are eligible for equity,  pay increases based on performance, benefits including health and dental care, and paid time off.

We understand that potential can be just as valuable as experience. If you're eager to learn, grow, and contribute to the mission but worry that you may not have the “right” experience, we still want you to apply. We encourage applications from everyone, regardless of background and life experience. We’re firm believers that a little bit of slope makes up for a lot of y-intercept.

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain parts of our hiring process. This can include tools that assist with scheduling, application review, candidate communications, and generating interview notes, guides, or summaries so our team can stay focused on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

Fluency in English is required due to the percentage of English-speaking customers and the nature of our platform, which is available to all Canadians.

item.title: Deployment Strategist (Japanese-Speaking) – Private Sector/Financial Services
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Data Analyst Jobs • Web3 Finance Jobs • Cryptocurrency Python Jobs • Cryptocurrency Remote Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs • Blockchain Web3 Jobs

Operating beyond the scope of conventional services or solutions engineering, Deployment Strategists function as embedded technical advisors. You will manage the entire spectrum of customer outcomes, initiating with deep discovery and investigative work and culminating in the design, integration, deployment, and long-term enablement of the customer.

This position sits at the intersection of analytical rigor, financial services expertise, and strategic customer partnership. You will engage directly with banks and other financial institutions to understand their operational goals, risk requirements, investigative needs, and compliance challenges, developing bespoke workflows that allow organizations to leverage Chainalysis independently.

Your impact hinges on strong investigative instincts, technical proficiency, an understanding of financial crime and compliance within banking, and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders. Japanese language fluency is required, both spoken and written.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own end-to-end customer engagements with banks and financial institutions, from discovery through investigation, solution design, deployment, enablement, and ongoing value delivery

  • Partner directly with banks and financial institutions to understand investigative, intelligence, compliance, fraud, AML, and operational objectives and translate them into actionable outcomes

  • Design, build, and maintain custom workflows, notebooks, dashboards, queries, and data models using Chainalysis data and products

  • Enable customers to operate solutions independently, building internal capability and embedding Chainalysis into their operational infrastructure

  • Act as the primary technical and domain advisor for customers, building trusted relationships through hands-on expertise and credibility

  • Deliver live training, demonstrations, investigative walkthroughs, and technical briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Support pre-sales technical engagement for complex and strategic financial services opportunities, helping customers understand what is possible and how to achieve it

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Global Intelligence, and Sales to influence the roadmap and improve offerings based on customer and market intelligence

  • Develop and share financial services domain expertise, investigative techniques, and best practices that raise the capability of the wider team

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Professional experience working directly with banks, financial institutions, or other financial services organizations

  • Fluency in both spoken and written Japanese

  • Conducted or directly supported cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain intelligence, financial crime analysis, AML, compliance, fraud, or related work in an operational environment

  • Strong understanding of how banks and financial institutions manage financial crime, compliance, risk, investigations, and digital asset exposure

  • Deep familiarity with blockchain ecosystems, including BTC, ETH, stablecoins and DeFi, and how on-chain data can be used within financial crime, compliance, risk, or investigative workflows

  • Delivered customer-facing technical solutions, whether investigative outputs, data products, or analytical workflows, in complex real-world environments

  • Built insights from large or complex datasets and communicated findings to varied audiences, from analysts to senior banking executives

  • Operated successfully in fast-paced, ambiguous environments requiring ownership, adaptability, and sound judgment

Required Skills:

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, transformation, and solution development

  • Experience building notebooks, dashboards, and analytical workflows

  • Solid understanding of data modelling, querying, and working with large datasets

  • Ability to quickly develop deep expertise in Chainalysis data structures, schemas, and products

Financial Services & Domain Expertise

  • Substantive experience working with banks or financial institutions is a must

  • Experience in one or more relevant domains, such as AML, financial crime investigations, fraud, sanctions and compliance, risk, cybercrime, or digital asset compliance

  • Understanding of how banks and financial institutions operate, including their investigative workflows, regulatory environment, risk frameworks, and stakeholder structures

  • Ability to apply financial services and domain expertise to shape investigative approaches, solution design, and customer advisory

  • Strong understanding of how blockchain intelligence and digital asset data can support banking, compliance, risk, and financial crime objectives

Customer & Communication Skills

  • Proven ability to build trusted, long-term relationships with banking and financial services customers through technical and domain credibility

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex investigative and data concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Fluent Japanese communication skills, both written and verbal

  • Comfortable leading customer sessions, workshops, training, and technical working groups

  • Experience enabling and upskilling customer teams, not just delivering outputs but building long-term customer capability

  • Ability to communicate effectively with senior banking, compliance, risk, AML, and financial crime stakeholders

AI at ChainalysisAI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

item.title: Principal Product Designer
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Product Designer Jobs • Web3 Senior Jobs • Cryptocurrency Finance Jobs • Cryptocurrency Remote Jobs • Web3 Full Time Jobs • Blockchain Web3 Jobs

About Figure

Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure’s on-chain lend-borrow marketplace. Figure’s ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933.Figure is the market leader in real-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple-A ratings from S&P and Moody’s on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance.We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies.

About the Role

Figure is looking for a Principal Product Designer to help shape the future of our financial products, with a primary focus on Figure Markets and opportunities to work across our broader lending ecosystem.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a designer who thrives in complex, ambiguous problem spaces. You will work on products that span investing, lending, borrowing, digital assets, capital markets, and emerging financial infrastructure, often in areas where the product model itself is still being defined.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, and business leaders to turn complicated financial concepts, technical constraints, regulatory requirements, and evolving customer needs into experiences that feel clear, intuitive, and trustworthy.

We are looking for someone who can move fluidly between big-picture product thinking and detailed execution. You should be comfortable challenging assumptions, identifying gaps in requirements, working through downstream logic and edge cases, and helping a team determine not just how a feature should work, but what the right product experience should be. At the Principal level, your impact should extend beyond the projects directly assigned to you. You will help establish patterns, improve how teams approach difficult design problems, mentor other designers, and raise the quality of product design across Figure.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead product design for complex initiatives across Figure Markets, while contributing to shared problems and experiences across Figure Lending and other products.
  • Take ambiguous or incomplete product requirements and turn them into coherent end-to-end experiences, identifying missing logic, dependencies, edge cases, and opportunities along the way.
  • Develop a deep understanding of financial concepts, customer workflows, business models, and technical constraints in order to simplify inherently complicated products.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering from early problem definition through implementation, helping shape requirements rather than simply designing against them.
  • Explore multiple approaches to difficult problems, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and help teams make informed product decisions.
  • Design sophisticated workflows, data-dense interfaces, account and transaction experiences, permissions, states, and other interaction models common to financial products.
  • Think beyond the primary happy path. Anticipate error states, lifecycle changes, permissions, regulatory constraints, system behavior, and downstream consequences of design decisions.
  • Create prototypes and high-fidelity designs that make complex product ideas tangible and help teams align quickly.
  • Work within and contribute to Figure’s evolving design system, identifying opportunities to establish reusable patterns without forcing unique product problems into generic solutions.
  • Partner closely with Engineering during implementation to preserve intent, resolve unexpected constraints, and maintain a high bar for product quality.
  • Use research, customer feedback, product data, domain expertise, and cross-functional input to inform design decisions.
  • Present work clearly to partners and senior leadership, explaining not only what you designed but how you arrived at the solution.
  • Provide thoughtful critique and mentorship to other designers, helping raise the quality of both the work and the thinking behind it.
  • Identify patterns and opportunities that span individual products, helping Figure create more coherent experiences across Markets, Lending, and future product areas.

What We Look For

  • 8+ years of product design experience, including significant experience owning complex products or major product areas.
  • A portfolio demonstrating strong product thinking, interaction design, and visual craft across real, shipped experiences.
  • A track record of solving complicated problems where requirements, customer needs, or the underlying product model were not fully defined at the outset.
  • Strong systems thinking and an ability to understand how decisions in one part of a product affect workflows, states, users, and systems elsewhere.
  • Excellent interaction design skills, particularly for sophisticated workflows, data-heavy products, and multi-step experiences.
  • Strong visual design fundamentals and a high bar for typography, hierarchy, layout, information density, interaction detail, and overall product polish.
  • The ability to independently drive work from early problem framing through detailed design and implementation.
  • Comfort working closely with engineers and understanding enough about technical systems to make pragmatic design decisions.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, including the ability to explain complicated concepts and design rationale to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience influencing Product and Engineering partners and constructively challenging requirements when a better customer or product outcome is possible.
  • A collaborative mindset and the ability to give and receive direct, thoughtful critique.
  • A customer-first approach that prioritizes clarity, trust, and usability over novelty or personal aesthetic preference.
  • Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
  • Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
  • Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing fintech, trading, investing, lending, crypto, capital markets, payments, or other financial products.
  • Experience working in regulated industries where compliance, permissions, disclosures, and operational constraints meaningfully affect the product experience.
  • Familiarity with institutional or professional financial workflows in addition to consumer products.
  • Experience with products involving complex account structures, transaction lifecycles, roles and permissions, or financial data.
  • Experience contributing to design systems and establishing reusable product patterns across teams.
  • Familiarity with front-end technologies and modern product development workflows.
  • Experience using prototyping and emerging AI tools to explore ideas, accelerate iteration, or improve the design and development process.

How You'll Make an Impact

Success in this role is not measured by the number of screens you produce. It is measured by your ability to bring clarity to difficult problems, improve the decisions a team makes, and create products that make sophisticated financial capabilities understandable and usable. You will help Figure build products that can support increasing complexity without feeling increasingly complicated, while raising the standard for product thinking and execution across the organization.

Salary

  • Base Compensation Range: $158,400 - $237,600/yr
  • 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly 
  • Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans
  • Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • 11 observed holidays and PTO plan
  • Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave
  • Continuing education reimbursement

Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing  and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice.

Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

item.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth & Experimentation – Krak
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Cryptocurrency Full Stack Jobs • Blockchain React Native Jobs • Blockchain Senior Jobs • Blockchain Remote Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 Jobs

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world’s longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join a small, dedicated growth and experimentation team within Krak, focused on accelerating acquisition, activation, engagement and trading activity across the Krak app. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: the majority of your work will be in React Native, supported by enough backend capability to take an experiment from idea to live without waiting on another team.

Rather than executing against a rigid roadmap, you’ll work closely with Product on a continuous pipeline of fast, lightweight experiments, owning each one from hypothesis through implementation, launch, measurement and iteration. The mandate is simple: find the highest-leverage opportunities to grow users and revenue, prove what works, and scale the winners – with direct, measurable impact on how millions of customers discover and use Kraken’s products.

The opportunity

  • Build and ship consumer-facing features quickly in React Native and TypeScript, favouring small, high-velocity experiments over long-running projects.

  • Own experiments end-to-end – hypothesis, design, build, launch, measurement and iteration – using platforms such as Statsig to test globally or within specific markets.

  • Improve onboarding, activation and feature discovery to drive conversion, engagement and trading revenue, iterating rapidly on features that are already live.

  • Build viral acquisition features and value-add growth features on top of Krak’s existing product offering.

  • Contribute to backend services and APIs wherever an experiment requires it, so you can ship across the stack without being blocked. Our backend is primarily Rust; prior Rust experience is not expected, but enthusiasm for picking it up is.

  • Read your own results, including trade-offs between conversion gains and other metrics, and decide whether to scale, iterate or kill – driving technical decisions autonomously amid evolving priorities and limited upfront planning.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of software development experience building and shipping large-scale, consumer-facing applications. Strong, hands-on React and React Native experience is essential.

  • Demonstrated experience running growth experiments at consumer-facing businesses, with measurable impact on conversion, activation, retention or revenue. This is a consumer growth role, so B2B or platform-only backgrounds are not a fit.

  • Working backend proficiency: you can design and implement services and APIs yourself. We care about backend fundamentals rather than any particular language, and you should be open to working in Rust.

  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals, with hands-on experience across APIs, WebSockets and real-time systems, mobile performance, testing, and modern development workflows.

  • Practical experience designing, running and analysing A/B tests – feature flags, statistical significance, product analytics, funnel and cohort data – with the judgement to act decisively on what the results show.

  • End-to-end ownership of product features and a strong product engineering mindset, with the initiative and adaptability to operate with minimal direction amid ambiguity and frequently changing priorities.

Nice to haves

  • Customer-facing product experience within fintech, digital banking, payments, trading or crypto.

  • Hands-on experience with Statsig or a comparable experimentation platform, including regional and global rollouts.

  • Rust experience, given our backend stack.

  • SQL and self-serve analytics, so you can pull and interrogate your own data.

  • AI fluency. Familiarity with how AI tools and patterns have fundamentally shifted your development workflow and problem-solving approach.

  • Native mobile development (iOS/Android), distributed systems or microservices, or engineering within a hyperscaling consumer technology organisation.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
