item.title: Client Success, LATAM
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Customer Support Jobs • Blockchain Finance Jobs • Cryptocurrency Full Time Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 Jobs • Web3 Stablecoin Jobs

About Us

OpenFX is on a mission to move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems. We are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of cross-border payment systems for institutions. The team's execution has been exceptional, and we're scaling at a remarkable pace. Our stellar early team brings experience at companies such as J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, FalconX, PayPal, Affirm, Polygon, Kraken, Nium, Visa, Mastercard and others. We're backed by Accel, Lightspeed, M13, Northzone, Pantera, and other top-tier investors.

About the Role

We are hiring a Client Success, LatAm to join our Latin America go-to-market team in Miami, reporting to the Head of Client Success, LatAm. You will own the day to day relationship for a portfolio of institutional clients, including payment companies, PSPs, fintechs, and digital asset platforms, and help them move more of their cross-border flow through OpenFX.

The role blends full ownership with close support. Roughly 60% of your time goes to running your own book of growing accounts end to end, and about 40% goes to supporting our largest Latin America relationships alongside the Head of Client Success. You will work daily with Sales, Trading Operations, Product, Compliance, and RevOps.

What You'll Do

  • Own a portfolio of institutional clients as their primary point of contact so every account has a clear owner and a relationship that keeps getting stronger.
  • Build and run an account growth plan for each client so you understand their business model, priorities, and where more of their FX flow can come to OpenFX.
  • Grow transaction volume by helping clients optimize their FX flows, pricing, and settlement setup so they trade more, and more often, on our platform.
  • Monitor client health and trading activity so you spot slowdowns early and bring accounts back before they go quiet.
  • Expand accounts through upsell and deeper product use so fast-growing clients become some of our largest relationships.
  • Own the cross-sell pipeline for new currency pairs and products as they launch globally so clients adopt more of the platform.
  • Price thoughtfully and escalate exceptions early so growth stays profitable.
  • Support our largest Latin America accounts on trades, settlement, pricing, and new product setup, partnering with Trading Ops and Product so issues get solved fast and client feedback shapes the roadmap.
  • Build and maintain a structured playbook for long-tail accounts so coverage stays consistent as the book scales.
  • Use AI to automate routine workflows and surface client insights, working with RevOps, so the team spends more time on high-value client conversations.

What You Should Bring

  • 3+ years in fintech or financial services, and 7+ years of total experience across account management, sales, consulting, or business operations.
  • Fluent in Spanish AND Portuguese
  • Working knowledge of payments and FX, including how cross-border flows, settlement, and pricing fit together.
  • A track record of managing and growing a book of clients independently, with full ownership of outcomes.
  • Confidence negotiating pricing and volume with senior client stakeholders.
  • Comfort with data: you use CRM and analytics tools to understand client health and decide where to spend your time.
  • Experience building repeatable account management systems for a large portfolio, not just a handful of top clients.
  • Advanced fluency with AI tools such as Claude, applied as a core part of how you work every day.
  • Clear, candid communication in writing and in person, including raising risks to leadership early.
  • Strong working relationships with Product, Operations, and Compliance teams, and the ability to get things prioritized for your clients.
  • A high degree of trust, comfort with ambiguity, and a bias for action. You own outcomes, not activity. Fluency with Google Workspace, Slack, and Notion. Based in or willing to relocate to Miami.

Even Better

  • Experience at a remittance company, PSP, neobank, or payment infrastructure company.
  • A strong understanding of FX markets and trading operations.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins and US payment rails such as ACH, Fedwire, and RTP.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Equity in a rapidly growing company.
  • Opportunity to work in a fast-paced startup at the forefront of fintech innovation.
  • Opportunity to make a significant impact on global financial infrastructure.
  • Collaborative work culture with emphasis on personal and professional growth.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Apply here 👉 Client Success, LATAM

OpenFX is on a mission to move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems. We are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of cross-border payment systems for institutions. The team's execution has been exceptional, and we're scaling at a remarkable pace. Our stellar early team brings experience at companies such as J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, FalconX, PayPal, Affirm, Polygon, Kraken, Nium, Visa, Mastercard and others. We're backed by Accel, Lightspeed, M13, Northzone, Pantera, and other top-tier investors.

About the Role

As Commercial Legal Counsel, you will run the commercial deal desk end-to-end and be the lead lawyer supporting OpenFX’s Go to Market team. You will create new global contractual frameworks to support our expanding set of products and markets, create templates for our partnership arrangements with local financial institutions, build and manage a Contract Management System, and expand our processes leveraging AI to enable the Legal team to rapidly and efficiently review and negotiate agreements and onboard new clients.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full commercial contracting lifecycle for our global customer relationships.
  • Build and maintain the commercial legal playbook - templates, fallback positions, approval thresholds, and  escalation paths so standard deals close without bespoke lawyering.
  • Create systems and processes enabling the team to leverage AI for first-pass contract review, issues lists, and clause comparison, and build reusable AI workflows that compress cycle times across the whole legal function.
  • Advise the team on deal structure, pricing and fee terms, service levels, liability and indemnity positions, and settlement and funds-flow mechanics.
  • Partner with regulatory Legal, Compliance, and Product on how regulatory requirements land in contract terms and customer-facing documentation.
  • Serve as the lead Counsel advising the global Go to Market team.

What You Should Bring

  • 10+ years of legal experience, with substantial time in commercial legal roles and in fintech, payments, or financial services - in-house at a high-growth company, at a top-tier firm, or both.
  • General knowledge of the regulatory frameworks related to cross-border payments and digital assets - money transmission, e-money, MiCA, and stablecoin issuance and payments.
  • Outstanding analytical and written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and ability to devise creative solutions to solve problems.
  • A bias for action and ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Humility and commitment to being a team player.
  • Excitement about building a company and working on complex issues at the cutting edge of payments, crypto and and technology. 
  • J.D. or equivalent, with active bar admission in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

Even Better

  • Experience as an early hire standing up a commercial legal function from scratch.

What We Offer

  • Equity in an early-stage, rapidly growing company
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Ability to work at the cutting edge of transformational change in global payments
  • Collaborative work culture
  • Significant opportunity for professional growth

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

item.title: Core Architect & Integration Lead — Applied AI
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Python Jobs • Blockchain Backend Jobs • Web3 Security Jobs • Cryptocurrency Remote Jobs • Web3 Full Time Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 Jobs • Cryptocurrency Stablecoin Jobs

About the Job

zerohash's Applied AI team manages two fronts: an internal Intelligence Core (a system connectivity and control layer) and external agentic-commerce products. This role acts as the engineering backbone for both—building the access layer, audit logging, skills/agents, and system architecture. The Applied AI team builds the Intelligence Core itself. Engineering maintains platform accounts, event hooks, and retrieval layers; this role builds everything above them.

Core objective: Connect company systems securely, and produce records of agent action that a third party can verify.

Strategic importance: The internal build acts as a sandbox for agentic commerce products. Identity, authority, write permissions, and tamper-evident logging will be proven internally before powering multi-institutional agentic networks.

Responsibilities

  • Own the access layer (native connectors, MCP servers, Databricks US/EU) using short-lived tokens, least-privilege read-only access, and zero raw PII while enforcing data residency.
  • Define a versioned schema for two signed record types of credentials and action records, in one namespace so each can be checked against the other.
  • Establish build discipline early: deployment pipelines, authority policy as code, skill merge gates, and signed builds with SBOMs.
  • Build the authority lease service with integrated kill switches.
  • Capture events into append-only, hash-chained logs for tamper-evident and independently verifiable auditing.
  • Migrate the team’s existing agents onto the Core, launch new per-department agents and lead security reviews for continuous read access.
  • Extend the Core from read to bounded write: logged actions, idempotency keys, compensating actions, and multi-approver time-locks for anything that moves money.
  • Design core primitives for cross-institution interoperability, wrapping actions in signed mandates, scoped authority, and attestation receipts compatible with standards like x402, AP2, and MPP.
  • Design self-hosted, zero-egress private stacks when required by classification evidence.
  • Evaluate and integrate state-of-the-art developments in agent frameworks, confidential inference, and zero-knowledge attestations.
  • Maintain a security-first posture by threat-modeling prompt injection, credential exfiltration, and confused-deputy risks upfront.

Requirements

  • Senior, Python-first backend engineering with production experience in event-driven systems, API integration, and CI/CD.
  • Agent-system experience — composing LLM agents (Claude, GPT, or comparable; Bedrock or comparable platforms) into standing systems — with the judgment to keep the models at the edges and the control plane deterministic.
  • Demonstrate security-first habits in a regulated environment (MSB/VASP, bank, or comparable): least privilege and read-only as reflexes, not requirements to be reminded of.
  • Working familiarity with capability-based authorization: attenuable tokens, workload identity, policy-as-code.

Preferred

  • Verifiable credentials, HTTP message signatures, or any of the emerging agent-payment mandate schemes (x402, AP2, MPP, Visa TAP, Mastercard Agent Pay).
  • Self-hosted LLM stacks; confidential computing / trusted execution environments.
  • A research habit and autonomy: this is a foundational seat on a new team, with wide scope and few hand-holds.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

Follow us

Twitter

LinkedIn

Blog

item.title: Engineering Lead, Wallets (NYC)
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Engineering Manager Jobs • Blockchain Backend Jobs • Cryptocurrency Solidity Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs • Web3 Web3 Jobs • Cryptocurrency Stablecoin Jobs

About Crossmint

Global financial rails are undergoing a once-in-a-generation transformation. Instant settlement. Programmable. Agent-first. Crossmint is the infrastructure helping companies build for that future.We are the leading all-in-one stablecoin and wallet infrastructure platform, enabling fintechs, enterprises, and agentic platforms to integrate stablecoin rails with speed, compliance, and scale. Crossmint provides everything enterprises need to ship smart financial rails, including smart wallets, cross-chain stablecoin orchestration, on/offramps, token checkout, and more, all through a single developer-friendly API.Trusted by more than 40,000 clients including global leaders like MoneyGram, Western Union, and Paga to nation states like the Marshall Islands, Crossmint powers stablecoin flows that move billions from cross-border remittances, global payroll, to the world's first digital UBI program.MiCA-authorized, PSD2-licensed, and SOC2 Type II certified, Crossmint serves 150+ countries globally across 50+ blockchains. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Franklin Templeton, NYCA, First Round, and Lightspeed Faction.We're building the infrastructure for the era of programmable finance. Join us!

Location

New York, New York.

Type of employment

Full-time, indefinite contract

Seniority

3+ years of experience

Compensation

Base salary range: $225,000 - $250,000

Note: This range reflects base salary only. Final level, team assignment, and compensation are determined during the interview process based on experience and fit.

About The Role

Wallets sit at the center of everything Crossmint does. Every stablecoin payment, payout, and agentic transaction our clients run goes through our smart-wallet stack, which today spans EVM, Solana, and Stellar and serves enterprises like MoneyGram, OpenSea, and the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

As Engineering Lead for Wallets, you'll own the technical direction of that infrastructure end to end. You'll set the roadmap, make the key architectural calls, and lead a team of six engineers while continuing to write and ship production code yourself.

You'll work closely with Product, GTM, and Customer Success Engineering to turn enterprise requirements into on-chain primitives, and you'll represent the team in conversations with partners and vendors. This is a hands-on leadership role based in our New York office.

What You Will Do

  • Serving as Engineering Lead for the Wallets team, owning the full technical roadmap and strategy for Crossmint's programmable smart-wallet infrastructure across EVM, Solana, and Stellar blockchains.

  • Driving end-to-end architectural design and delivery of on-chain wallet primitives including smart-contract signers, recovery signers, delegated signer scopes/permissions, gas sponsorship, wallet creation billing, device signers, and multi-chain transaction orchestration via Temporal distributed workflows.

  • Leading the technical direction for wallet products serving enterprise clients such as MoneyGram, Marshall Islands (UBI program), OpenSea, and Robinhood Chain, as well as agentic-payments customers integrating Crossmint's wallet stack with Mastercard, Cloudflare, and AWS Agent Core Payments.

  • Coordinating directly with the GTM, CSE, and Product teams to align wallet roadmap priorities with commercial requirements, including defining differentiation positioning around on-chain programmability, no-vendor-lock-in architecture, and enterprise-grade stablecoin product integration.

  • Establishing and enforcing engineering best practices for the team: code quality standards, PR review guidelines, AI-assisted development workflows using Devin, structured sprint planning, retro action items, and technical documentation.

  • Setting up and maintaining observability infrastructure including Datadog dashboards for endpoint success rates, latency, and transaction throughput across all wallet-related services.

  • Managing a team of 6 direct reports across seniority levels (2 senior contractors, 2 senior engineers, 2 mid-level engineers), overseeing onboarding, performance coaching, and technical mentoring.

  • Representing the wallets team in cross-functional planning, product status updates, architectural reviews, and external vendor/partner technical calls (Temporal, ZeroDev, Phala, Alchemy, Rain).

  • Actively contributing production code: designing and merging complex PRs spanning wallet signer authorization, EVM UserOperation bundler flows, Solana fee estimation, Stellar V2 smart contract infrastructure, card-collateral topup workflows, and SDK bug fixes across web and mobile (React Native, Expo, Kotlin, Flutter).

Telecommuting permitted up to 1 day/week.

What We Are Looking For

Must-haves

Crossmint will accept three (3) years of experience in the job offered or in a Full-Stack Engineer or Engineering Lead-related occupation.

Position requires demonstrable experience in the following:

  • TypeScript: designing scalable, production-grade full-stack applications and decentralized wallet interfaces, including high-performance React integrations.

  • Developing resilient backend services using NestJS, distributed task orchestration via Temporal workers, blockchain data processing, and real-time event handling.

  • Building, auditing, and deploying Solidity and Stellar/Soroban smart contracts in production environments, ensuring compliance with security standards and gas-optimization best practices (including Halborn/Latacora audit remediation).

  • Designing and maintaining multi-chain blockchain infrastructure components across EVM (Ethereum, Polygon, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Base), Solana, and Stellar: smart-contract factories, event indexers, webhook pipelines, and on-chain/off-chain data systems.

  • Designing and deploying monitoring, observability, and fault-tolerant solutions using Datadog and Temporal to ensure system resilience and high throughput at scale.

  • Leading and mentoring engineering teams including conducting technical interviews, defining best-practice standards, and driving code quality through structured review processes.

  • Managing distributed AI-assisted engineering workflows (Devin) to accelerate delivery while maintaining architecture integrity and code quality.

Why Join Crossmint?

  • Build regulated infrastructure at scale. We're one of the few stablecoin infrastructure providers licensed under MiCA across all 27 EU member states, and the wallets you build will move real money for global enterprises.

  • Work on products with real-world impact. Our stack powers MoneyGram's stablecoin cross-border experience in LATAM and the Marshall Islands' national digital UBI program.

  • Own what you build. We're a team of around 80 people, so your technical decisions shape the product directly, with no layers between you and the people using it.

  • Stay at the frontier. You'll work on agentic payments with partners like Mastercard, Cloudflare, and AWS, along with multichain infrastructure across EVM, Solana, and Stellar.

  • Join a global team. We have offices in New York, Miami, Madrid, and Buenos Aires, and we're backed by Ribbit Capital, Franklin Templeton, NYCA, First Round, and Lightspeed Faction.

Benefits

  • Extensive access to leading AI tools and subscriptions, with AI actively encouraged and integrated into daily workflows.

  • Unlimited, flexible PTO.

  • Parental Leave program.

  • Flexible work schedule.

  • Company laptop and allowance for any necessary home equipment.

  • Daily stipend for commuting to the office and/or meals.

  • Two company-paid off-sites each year.

  • Health, dental, vision, life, short-term disability (STD), and long-term disability (LTD) insurances.

  • 401(k) Plan.

Our Principles

  • Results and delivery: Ship high quality work fast.

  • Build for the long term: Build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions. Use AI.

  • Extreme Ownership: Be an effective Directly Responsible Individual (DRI). Be proactive.

  • Be a team player: Be an effective and kind colleague providing credible challenge. Be present and reliable.

Talent research indicates that women are often less inclined than men to apply for a role unless they have experience in 100% of the listed skills. However, this list is only a guide. We welcome your application even if you feel you meet around 75% of the requirements. At Crossmint, we believe skills can be learned, and diversity makes us stronger.

We work to foster a respectful environment where each person can be their authentic self, free from harassment, racism, and any form of discrimination. We proudly uphold our commitment to diversity and inclusion as an equal opportunity employer, and this policy applies to all employment practices within our organization.

Please note that Crossmint never conducts AI-based interviews, and all of our processes include an initial video call with a team member. Crossmint will not request your personal identification documents or any payment at any point during your interview process. Please stay vigilant about potential fraud. If you receive an email that claims to be from Crossmint but ends with any domain other than @crossmint.com, @crossmint.io or @paella.dev, it is not from us. We own these three domains listed before, and they are the only legitimate ones.

Please let our Talent Team know if you need any assistance completing any forms, or participating in the process.

Who will be in contact with you

Our People Ops team will be joining you throughout the entirety of the interview and onboarding processes. Feel free to reach out if you need anything!

  • Adolfo Fernández - Head of People Ops

  • Gloria Alogo - People Ops, Onboarding & Benefits

⚠️ Please note that these are the only members of our People Ops team. Please remain vigilant and watch out for impersonators.

Follow us on Linkedin and X to keep updated with our latest activity! 👣

Apply here 👉 Engineering Lead, Wallets (NYC)

About the Job

This role builds a canonical entity and knowledge graph across Intelligence Core connectors to resolve identities (people, agents, systems, data entities). The entity layer supports data classification at the source to unify transaction reporting.

Core Objective: Automate system-level identity, authority and permissions.

Strategic Importance: Underpins security, core authority models, registers, and kill switches internally, while providing the foundation for agentic commerce credentials externally.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the classify-at-source pilot with Finance and Compliance to establish unified tag models and metrics without re-derivation.
  • Establish shadow-AI and agent-identity registers to define ownership, access controls, and data permissions.
  • Build entity resolution pipelines across internal systems (Slack, Jira, Ironclad) using privacy-preserving linkage and canonical IDs.
  • Develop graph-based correlation skills (e.g., Jira gap-finder) and establish verifiable baseline metrics for operational throughput and SAR false positives.
  • Ground operational agents in the shared graph to deliver unified event tracking, reasoning, and real-time authorization.
  • Define graph architecture, governing schemas, temporal permissions, and provenance tracking to ensure full auditability and agent compatibility.
  • Maintain data accuracy using bitemporal modeling, automated drift detection, and historical replay capabilities for compliance.
  • Model delegation chains and agent credentials anchored to human principals for secure external interoperability.
  • Deploy ML and graph-native methods to analyze multi-agent behaviors, detect anomalies, and identify shared lineage or prompts.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging graph and identity resolution research.
  • Enforce strict regulatory compliance, jurisdictional data partitioning, and privacy-by-design standards across the identity layer.

Requirements

  • Direct experience with entity resolution, identity systems or knowledge-graph modelling.
  • Strong Python plus graph or relational data engineering in production.
  • Applied ML for resolution at scale, potentially including embedding- and LLM-based matching, self-supervised and active-learning loops, with the discipline to benchmark before trusting, on synthetic or de-identified sets, since raw PII never enters an evaluation.

  • Comfort working directly with Finance and Compliance colleagues on a live data pilot from the first weeks.

item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Operations Jobs • Blockchain KYC Jobs • Web3 Remote Jobs • Cryptocurrency Full Time Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Stablecoin JobsJoin Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance
At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.Innovate with Tether
Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?
About the job
As a member of the Legal Operations team, you will support a diverse range of legal operations matters, with a primary focus on managing and responding to “Know Your Customer” / “Know Your Business” (KYC/KYB) requests, reviewing and maintaining a database of corporate documents, and supporting requests from the Company’s customer’s various business lines. You will support business lines spanning stablecoins, artificial intelligence, peer-to-peer communications applications, education, power, and human evolution, helping to explain those businesses to internal stakeholders and external parties including banks, vendors, auditors, and customers. The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, cross-border environment.
Responsibilities
• Acting as a key point of contact for KYC/KYB questions and coordinating responses to requests from banks, vendors, auditors, and customers;
• Managing, updating, and maintaining a database of corporate documents to ensure accuracy and completeness;
• Managing and overseeing access to the database of corporate documents, including permissions and version control;
• Preparing and reviewing, ng corporate documentation;
• Finding and implementing efficiencies and process improvements across legal operations workflows;
• Identifying and mitigating or escalating legal risks and issues;
• Explaining our customer’s various business lines to internal business groups and external stakeholders;
• Addressing ad hoc requests and projects as they arise.Apply here 👉 Legal Operations Assistant

item.description:

At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
But that’s just the beginning:
Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.Why Join Us?
Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
Are you ready to be part of the future?About the job
We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly.
We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!Responsibilities
In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.You will:

  • Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
  • Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
  • Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
  • Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
  • Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for qualityJob requirements
  • Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga
  • Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
  • Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.
  • Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.
  • Experience working with a remote team
  • Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.
  • Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks.Apply here 👉 Mobile Engineer - React Native (100% Remote)

item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Security Jobs • Cryptocurrency Smart Contract Jobs • Web3 Backend Jobs • Cryptocurrency Rust Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 JobsAbout the CompanyFounded in 2018 by professors of Yale University and Columbia University, CertiK is a pioneer in blockchain security, utilizing best-in-class AI technology to secure and monitor blockchain protocols and smart contracts. CertiK’s mission is to secure the cyber world. Starting with blockchain, CertiK applies cutting-edge innovations from academia into enterprise, enabling mission-critical applications to be built with security and correctness. CertiK is one of the fastest growing and most trusted companies in blockchain security and has become a true market leader. Our clients include leading projects such as Aave, Polygon, Binance Smart Chain, Yearn, and Chiliz. Our investors include top VCs like Tiger Global, Coatue Management, Shunwei Capital and Hillhouse Capital as well as industry leaders like Coinbase Ventures and Binance.About the PositionThe primary responsibility of this role is contributing to CertiK’s security-related services at the intersection of cybersecurity and blockchain. CertiK’s offerings include security consulting, security reviews, and security auditing of smart contracts and blockchains, alongside penetration testing and various verification processes.As a Security Engineer at CertiK, , You’ll discover and analyze security vulnerabilities in blockchain smart contracts, summarize attacked vulnerabilities, and design feature code analysis tools. You’ll also stay up-to-date with analysis tools and new technology trends to further strengthen CertiK’s security offerings and expand our services.

Responsibilities

  • Participate in blockchain smart contract audits, identifying, analyzing, and addressing security vulnerabilities.
  • Help evaluate and define attack models for blockchain security.
  • Summarize and extract key characteristics from exploited code to build and maintain tools for feature code analysis.
  • Research and work with different analysis tools, continually learning and adapting to emerging technologies in the space.

Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree (or higher) in full-time education, preferably in a science or engineering field, plus 3+ years of work experience.
  • Familiarity with fundamental information security concepts.
  • Proficiency in at least one of the following languages: Solidity, Go, Rust, C++, Python, or Node.js, along with a solid grasp of common algorithms.
  • A demonstrated ability to function in an English working environment with strong English reading and writing skills.
  • A passion for blockchain technology and a drive to learn and adapt to new technologies.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working with production pipelines—maintaining or developing them.
  • Familiarity with static code analysis (e.g., Syntax Analysis, Semantic Analysis, Taint analysis).
  • Exposure to popular blockchain-related platforms and technologies (e.g., Ethereum, Hyperledger, Cosmos).
  • Prior knowledge of blockchain smart contracts, security audits, and associated best practices.
  • Hands-on blockchain experience such as evaluating risks for blockchain projects or analyzing on-chain security events.
Target annual salary for this role performed is $90,000 - $150,000 if based in the US. The exact compensation at which this job is filled will be determined by the skills and experience of qualified candidates.CertiK accepts applications for this position on an ongoing basis. CertiK is proud to offer medical, vision, and dental insurance, 401(k) plan with company matching, life and accidental death and dismemberment insurance, HSA (with high deductible plan), FSA, and other benefits to all full-time employees, along with flexible paid time off and holidays. CertiK also offers a variable commission program for business development sales roles. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. CertiK is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of age, race, color, creed, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, medical condition, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status or civil partnership/union status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, genetic information, military and veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, state or local law. CertiK will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with local and federal requirements.https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/migrated_files/employers/poster_screen_reader_optimized.pdf All CertiK employees are expected to actively support diversity on their teams, and in the Company.We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.Apply here 👉 Blockchain Security Expert - Anti Defect Track

item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain SRE Jobs • Blockchain Security Jobs • Web3 Infrastructure Jobs • Web3 Full Time Jobs • Blockchain Web3 Jobs

Responsibilities:

  • Act as Escalation Point of Contact: Serve as the primary Level 3 escalation point for resolving complex network infrastructure, routing, and security configuration issues across both on-premise Data Centers and AWS environments.
  • Maintain Multi-Vendor Security & Perimeter Solutions: Responsible for the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of FortiGate Firewalls (On-Prem & AWS), Cisco ASA Firewalls, and Akamai WAF / Anti-DDoS solutions protecting core endpoints.
  • Manage Core Network & Infrastructure Services: Identify and resolve network issues, bottlenecks, and vulnerabilities across Arista core/access switches, Cisco routers, F5 Load Balancers (LTM/GTM), and Infoblox (DNS/DHCP).
  • Develop & Maintain Architecture Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation on network topology, hybrid cloud designs, system security configurations, and operational SOPs.
  • Bridge Infrastructure and DevOps (IaC): Bridge the gap between development and operations by embracing "Infrastructure as Code" (IaC) in close collaboration with DevOps teams to automate network deployments and security workflows.
  • Integrate AI & Network Task Automation: Research and leverage automation/AI tools (e.g., Tines, n8n, Dify) for Security Orchestration or network task automation to improve operational efficiency.
  • Provide Support During Non-Office Hours: Provide non-office hour escalation support whenever needed during major live cutovers or critical network emergencies.

Requirements:

  • Relevant education in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting production networks across on-premises data centers and AWS environments.
  • Experience with firewall configuration, routing, switching, network security, and incident response.
  • Working knowledge of relevant networking protocols, including BGP, OSPF, IPsec, HSRP, and QoS.
  • Experience with hybrid-cloud networking, including AWS VPC networking and AWS Direct Connect.
  • Ability to work independently, prioritize incidents effectively, and communicate clearly during operational issues.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience with one or more of the following security and edge technologies: FortiGate, Cisco ASA, Akamai WAF, or anti-DDoS solutions.
  • Experience with one or more of the following infrastructure technologies: Arista switches, Cisco routers, F5 LTM/GTM, or Infoblox DNS/DHCP.
  • CCNP, CCIE, AWS Certified Advanced Networking, CISSP, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code and network automation.
  • Experience with security-orchestration or workflow-automation tools such as Tines, n8n, or Dify.
  • Experience executing or supporting live data-center-to-AWS migration cutovers.

item.title: Product Engineering Lead, Keet
item.description: Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Engineering Manager Jobs • Cryptocurrency Product Manager Jobs • Web3 React Jobs • Web3 Remote Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Stablecoin JobsJoin Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT, relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET, our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education: Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design. We're taking Keet to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. Product sets the direction. We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up at global scale. You lead the teams that build Keet's features: the API team, which adds feature-focused APIs to Keet's core, and the frontend team, which builds the React app on top, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar. The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for distributed, local-first systems, so you can work fluently on top of a P2P engine without needing to build it yourself. Responsibilities Engineering Run the API and frontend teams day to day: unblocking, reviewing, and keeping them shipping. Set and hold a high engineering bar for performance, reliability, and clean APIs. Own the technical design of features and the API surface between Keet's core and the app. Make sure the API team works closely with our deep tech teams on code reviews, design, and anything that touches the engine. Product Partnership Work alongside Keet's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work. Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist. Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially where P2P opens doors that centralized apps can't. Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them. Leadership Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like. Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders. Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.Apply here 👉 Product Engineering Lead, Keet

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

Remote - US (Washington, DC preferred)

Role

US regulatory engagement is Morpho's top legal priority. The SEC, CFTC, Treasury and FinCEN are writing the rules that will govern onchain lending, and the volume of rulemakings, requests for comment and staff engagement now exceeds what Legal can cover alongside its other work. Reporting to the General Counsel, this role owns Morpho's US policy pipeline end to end, from tracking rulemakings to drafting submissions and leading meetings with agency staff, Congress and industry coalitions.

Responsibilities

  • Track SEC, CFTC, Treasury and FinCEN rulemakings, guidance, staff statements and enforcement relevant to onchain lending, and maintain a live calendar of comment deadlines with a recommended posture for each.

  • Lead the drafting of comment letters, responses to requests for comment and other written submissions, pulling in input from Protocol, Product, Research and outside counsel, and prepare them for General Counsel sign-off.

  • Prepare and lead meetings with agency staff and commissioner offices, including briefing materials, talking points and follow-up submissions.

  • Represent Morpho in trade association working groups and industry coalitions, and coordinate Morpho's input into joint filings.

  • Engage congressional offices and committee staff on legislation and its implementation where it affects DeFi lending.

  • Manage outside policy counsel and consultants day to day: scope, deliverables and spend.

  • Brief leadership and product teams on US policy developments in short written updates, and flag implications for the protocol, products and external messaging.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

You can explain Morpho Markets, Morpho Vaults and the role of curators accurately to a non-technical regulator. You have built a tracker of open SEC, CFTC, Treasury and FinCEN items with a recommended posture for each, joined the relevant working groups, and contributed to at least one live comment letter or coalition submission.

First 3 months

You own the comment pipeline end to end: first drafts reach the General Counsel on schedule with no missed deadlines. You have prepared and led at least two agency meetings, send a short monthly US policy update to leadership, and have working relationships with staff at the SEC, the CFTC and key congressional offices.

First 6 months

Agency staff and coalition partners treat Morpho as a credible, technical voice on DeFi lending, and Morpho's positions show up in coalition filings and, where possible, in staff guidance or final rules. Outside counsel runs against clear deliverables and within budget, and you have drafted a 2027 US policy plan for General Counsel approval.

Must Have Skills & Experience

  • 5 to 8 years working on SEC or CFTC matters, at an agency, in a law firm regulatory practice, at a trade association or on an in-house regulatory or policy team. Prior SEC or CFTC staff experience is strongly preferred.

  • Strong working knowledge of federal securities and commodities law and of the rulemaking process: notice and comment, staff guidance, no-action and exemptive relief.

  • Excellent writing, with comment letters, regulatory submissions or similar work product to show for it.

  • Existing relationships with agency staff, congressional staff or industry coalitions.

  • Able to learn how onchain lending works and explain it clearly and accurately to a non-technical audience.

  • Sound judgment on when to escalate, and comfortable preparing positions for sign-off rather than setting them alone.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: doesn't wait to be told.

  • Clear and crisp async communication across a team split between Paris, New York and DC.

  • Comfort operating in fast-changing, ambiguous contexts.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Apply here 👉 US Policy Lead

item.title: AI Engineer
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Machine Learning Jobs • Blockchain Backend Jobs • Cryptocurrency Python Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Stablecoin Jobs

Jeeves is the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises. Thousands of companies across 35 countries run their corporate cards, payments, treasury and spend on one platform, with more than $5B in annualized volume, payouts to 190 countries, and one of the fastest-growing stablecoin payment networks in the world. BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP are among them, and more than 80% of customers use multiple Jeeves products.

We chose hard problems on purpose.

We hire for one thing: relentlessness. A strong motor that keeps going when the problem has no playbook. You'll know in your first week if Jeeves is right for you. For the right people, it's the steepest learning curve of your career.

Jeeves has raised more than $400 million in equity funding from Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Coinbase Ventures, GIC, AllianceBernstein, CoinFund and others.

If you want to rebuild how money moves across borders, come build it with us.

Jeeves is building AI into the core of its financial platform — from intelligent spend categorization and anomaly detection to LLM-powered workflows that help finance teams move faster. We're looking for a AI Engineer who is obsessed with building AI systems that actually work in production: reliable, observable, cost-efficient, and genuinely useful.

This is not a research role. You will ship AI-powered features that process real financial data for real businesses. You'll work alongside backend engineers, data scientists, and product teams to take AI from prototype to production — and you'll help define how Jeeves builds with AI as the company scales.

If you've built LLM pipelines, designed RAG architectures, operated ML systems in production, and care deeply about what happens when your AI makes a wrong call in a financial context — we want to meet you.

Location: This is a full-time remote position. #LI-REMOTE

What You'll Do:

LLM & AI Pipeline Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain production-grade LLM integration pipelines — including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt engineering, output parsing, and chain orchestration.

  • Develop and operate AI features within Jeeves's core financial products: spend categorization, document extraction, anomaly detection, financial Q&A, and automated reconciliation.

  • Implement structured output validation, fallback handling, and confidence scoring to ensure AI decisions meet reliability standards for financial use cases.

  • Evaluate and integrate AI frameworks and tools (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI API, Anthropic API, HuggingFace, vector databases) and advocate for the right tool for the job.

  • Establish prompt versioning and evaluation practices to ensure AI outputs remain accurate and consistent as models and data evolve.

Retrieval & Vector Search

  • Design and maintain vector search pipelines using databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, or pgvector to power semantic search and RAG-based features.

  • Build document ingestion and chunking pipelines for Jeeves's financial data — processing invoices, receipts, policy documents, and transaction records.

  • Optimize retrieval quality through embedding model selection, chunk strategy, metadata filtering, and re-ranking techniques.

ML Model Serving & Operations

  • Collaborate with data scientists to take trained ML models from experimental notebooks to production serving infrastructure.

  • Build and maintain model serving endpoints with appropriate latency SLOs, input validation, and output monitoring.

  • Implement model performance monitoring and data drift detection to ensure production models remain accurate over time.

  • Support model retraining workflows by designing clean data pipelines and feature engineering that can be continuously updated.

Backend Integration & Reliability

  • Integrate AI services cleanly with Jeeves's backend microservices — designing clear API contracts, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation patterns.

  • Write high-quality, testable backend code in Python or Go/Node.js to power AI-integrated features.

  • Instrument AI components with structured logging, distributed tracing, latency dashboards, and alerting to ensure operational visibility.

  • Build human-in-the-loop review workflows for AI decisions that require oversight — particularly for high-value financial actions.

Collaboration & Growth

  • Partner with Product, Backend Engineering, and Data Science to define the AI roadmap and translate requirements into reliable systems.

  • Contribute to a culture of quality by writing design docs, reviewing peers' AI system designs, and sharing learnings openly.

  • Help grow the AI engineering practice at Jeeves by establishing patterns, tooling, and best practices that the broader team can build on.

Requirements:

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML systems in production.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-powered applications using APIs such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Cohere in a production environment.

  • Experience designing and operating RAG pipelines, including chunking strategies, embedding models, and vector database integration (Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, or similar).

  • Strong proficiency in Python for AI/ML workloads; familiarity with at least one AI orchestration framework (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent).

  • Experience with ML model serving infrastructure: REST or gRPC inference endpoints, input/output validation, latency budgeting, and monitoring.

  • Solid backend engineering fundamentals: REST APIs, relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred), async patterns, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

  • Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, distributed tracing, and building dashboards for AI system health.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, financial services, or any regulated industry where AI reliability and auditability are critical.

  • Familiarity with prompt evaluation frameworks, A/B testing AI outputs, and tracking model performance degradation in production.

  • Experience with ML lifecycle management tools: MLflow, Weights & Biases, Vertex AI, or SageMaker.

  • Knowledge of real-time data streaming (Kafka, Kinesis) for event-driven AI pipelines.

  • Contributions to open-source AI tooling, published technical writing, or talks at AI/ML conferences.

  • Prior startup or scale-up experience — comfortable with ambiguity and building foundational systems from scratch.


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.Apply here 👉 AI Engineer

item.title: Senior Product Manager - Blockchain
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Cryptocurrency Product Manager Jobs • Cryptocurrency Senior Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 Jobs • Web3 Smart Contract Jobs • Web3 DeFi Jobs • Web3 Remote Jobs • Blockchain Stablecoin Jobs

ABOUT THE ROLE

Rain is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our onchain surface — the blockchain layer that everything else at Rain depends on. Stablecoins only work as real-world money if the onchain side is fast, safe, and invisible: collateral held in contracts, settlement across chains, custody and wallet architecture, and the asset and network coverage our partners need to operate globally. This role owns that.

This is a senior individual contributor role. You'll be the directly responsible PM for onchain end to end: smart contracts and protocol design, chain and asset integrations, settlement and treasury flows, and the infrastructure underneath it all. You'll work closely with engineering, security, compliance, legal, and directly with our fintech, neobank, and institutional partners.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own the roadmap for Rain's onchain product — smart contracts, chain and asset coverage, settlement, and payments — and drive it end to end

  • Partner deeply with engineering on protocol and infrastructure tradeoffs (contract architecture and upgradeability, collateralization and liquidation logic, node/RPC reliability, gas and fee strategy, bridging and cross-chain messaging) and translate them into partner-facing product decisions

  • Decide which chains, assets, and stablecoins Rain supports and when — build the framework for those calls across liquidity, security, cost, partner demand, compliance considerations, and regulatory exposure

  • Drive the security bar for onchain work — audits, monitoring, incident response, and the operational guardrails that go with holding real value onchain

  • Translate complex protocol and blockchain infrastructure into intuitive product surfaces and clear partner-facing documentation

  • Gather feedback directly from partners, distill it into sharp prioritization, and push the team toward the highest-leverage work

  • Measure ruthlessly, iterate quickly, and set a bar others want to work to

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 8-10 years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping products from zero-to-one through scale at a product-led company with a strong engineering culture and high bar for quality

  • Deep, hands-on blockchain fluency — you've shipped onchain products and can reason unaided about EVM and Solana mechanics (and other chains), smart contract design and upgrade patterns, gas economics, bridging models, and other onchain tradeoffs

  • Exceptional product judgment and analytical rigor — you're someone others describe as one of the sharpest PMs they've worked with, and you consistently raise the bar for the people around you

  • A senior, autonomous operator who can define the problem, drive the plan, and own the outcome without needing close direction

  • Sound instincts on onchain security and risk: you know where value gets lost, you push for audits and monitoring before incidents rather than after, and you can weigh a shipping deadline against a real risk without flinching

  • Strong technical fluency beyond the chain itself (APIs, distributed systems, payments and ledger design) and the instinct to pull on technical threads yourself rather than defer to engineering

  • Genuinely excited to live in the details — you believe product quality is won in the specifics and are energized by the work to get them right

  • Excellent written and verbal communication; you can operate with sophisticated external partners and internal engineering teams with equal ease

  • Proven ability to ship quickly, measure adoption, and iterate in a fast-moving environment

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT MANDATORY

  • Experience with stablecoin issuance, onchain lending or collateralized credit, or tokenized asset products

  • Background at a protocol, L1/L2, wallet, custodian, or onchain infrastructure company

  • Familiarity with non-EVM ecosystems (Solana, Tron, Bitcoin L2s) and multi-chain operations at scale

  • Experience with payments, card issuing, or cross-border fintech products

  • Working knowledge of the regulatory landscape around digital assets and custody

  • Previous startup or hypergrowth environment experience

    Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy, and happy experience at Rain:

    • Unlimited time off 🌴 Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take at least 10 days off.

    • Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace. If you feel comfortable at home, please work from home. If you’d like to work with others in an office, feel free to come in. We want everyone to be able to work in the environment in which they are their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers will receive a stipend to create a comfortable home environment.

    • Easy to access benefits 🧠For US Rainmakers, we offer comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans for you and your dependents, as well as a 100% company subsidized life insurance plan.

    • Retirement goals💡Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

    • Equity plan 📦 We offer every Rainmaker an equity option plan so we can all benefit from our success.

    • Rain Cards 🌧️ We want Rainmakers to be knowledgeable about our core products and services. To support this mission, we issue a card for our team to use for testing.

    • Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers are welcome to use their card for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

    • Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain! Time spent together helps us get to know each other, strengthen our relationships, and build a common destiny. Expect team and company off-sites both domestically and internationally.

Apply here 👉 Senior Product Manager - Blockchain

Requirements:

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world's financial markets.

Cryptocurrencies are the most disruptive change the financial services industry has seen in years. Join us and you'll be able to look back and say you were part of the team that transformed investing.

About the Job

As a Director of Enterprise Sales, you’ll be joining the Revenue team at zerohash to support our continued expansion in the US and globally.

We are looking for a self-starting individual who has demonstrated success operating in a high-growth environment, with excellent communication skills, creating, and an ability to understand unique customer needs. You will be responsible for understanding customer needs, then developing and delivering strategic sales presentations, negotiating and closing deals. The ideal candidate combines a deep understanding of crypto and fintech across payments and investments platforms, with the entrepreneurial spirit necessary for innovation in the crypto space. Although previous sales experience is beneficial, we are seeking an individual who grasps our product and is genuinely enthusiastic about exploring novel use cases and identifying potential new placements for zerohash.

This is a remote role.

#LI-Remote

Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue Generation: Identify potential revenue opportunities, conduct pre-sales consultations, deliver customized presentations, and provide expert insights to create new revenue streams.
  • Effective Communication: Investigate and understand the business objectives, goals, and challenges of potential clients. Create persuasive presentations that articulate the value of zerohash's API solution in a way that resonates with prospective customers, assisting them in attaining their business objectives.
  • Exceed Performance Targets: Consistently outperform monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets and essential KPIs.
  • Data-Driven Reporting: Maintain precise, up-to-the-minute records in Salesforce.com, including meticulous activity logs and revenue pipelines.
  • Negotiation Mastery: Skillfully navigate complex negotiations with the appropriate level of leadership within a prospective company to successfully close high-value customer contracts.
  • Cross-Selling Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams to spot cross-selling possibilities.
  • Product Insights: Assist in setting product development priorities based on customer feedback and experiences.
  • Travel: Be prepared to travel up to 40% of the time.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated Experience: A track record of success in enterprise sales, preferably within the tech industry, or valuable experience in product development or pre-sales, with a strong record of meeting and exceeding performance targets.
  • Creative Pitching: Ability to leverage presentation tools such as Google Slides, Figma and prototyping tools such as Lucid Charts and Figma are a must have
  • Industry Knowledge: In-depth understanding of fintech and crypto, including emerging trends, technologies, and competitive landscapes.
  • Negotiation Skills: Strong negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to close complex, high-value deals.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, including the capacity to deliver compelling presentations and proposals.
  • Relationship Building: Proven ability to build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with clients at all levels.
  • Effective Deal Sourcing: Demonstrated ability to proactively identify and secure new opportunities, showcasing a 'hunter' mentality.

Benefits

  • Healthcare Insurance: zerohash covers roughly 100% of employee premiums as well as a portion of spouse/children (U.S. only)
  • Vision & Dental Insurance (U.S. only)
  • Chance to earn equity
  • Maternity & Paternity leave (after 6 months)
  • WeWork All Access Membership
  • WFH Yearly Stipend
  • L&D Yearly Stipend (after 6 months)

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zerohash infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.
  • Passion - We are innovating quickly and challenging the status quo. We want you to think big, be creative and ​make a difference every day.
  • Collaborative - A good attitude and respect for others. We’re teammates, not co-workers. Everything we do is a shared success and equally a shared failure - we talk in terms of “we” not “me”.
  • Initiative - An ability and passion for learning and asking questions. We will champion you, challenge you and push you to achieve your best - and we expect you to do the same.
  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

We are building the VIP retail franchise for CFTC-regulated prediction markets and perpetual futures — including crypto and equity perps. As VIP Sales Manager, you own a book of high-volume individual traders: acquire them, get them live, keep them trading, and turn them into durable volume.

This is a relationship-first sales role for sophisticated retail / prosumer traders — crypto perps whales, prediction-market power users, sportsbook/CFD VIPs migrating onshore, and active equity-derivatives traders. You run the full motion end to end: source leads, convert, onboard, retain, and win back. You are the primary point of contact for your top accounts and the voice of the trader back into Product, Risk, and Growth.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Build and own a pipeline of VIP retail traders who are a natural fit for event contracts and crypto/equity perps.
  • Drive the full sales cycle: outreach, qualification, conversion, onboarding, and ongoing high-touch coverage.
  • Source new high-value traders from competitor venues (offshore perps exchanges, other prediction markets, CFD brokers, sportsbooks) and convert them with clear positioning on liquidity, fees, UX, and regulatory edge.
  • Navigate each VIP to the right product mix — prediction markets vs. crypto perps vs. equity perps — based on how they actually trade.

  • Hit and report VIP KPIs: volume, active traders, new acquisitions, winbacks, and competitor migration.
  • Represent the brand in trader communities and at conferences/events where VIP retail traders congregate.

  • 3–5+ years in client-facing VIP sales, retail derivatives coverage, or BD at a crypto exchange, CFD broker, prediction market, sportsbook VIP desk, or similar.

  • Fluency in how retail/prosumer traders use perps and event contracts: leverage, margin modes, funding, fees, and what actually moves volume.
  • Proven ability to source from cold, close, and monetize VIP relationships against volume or revenue targets.
