About the Company

Rain makes the next generation of payments possible across the globe. We’re a lean and mighty team of passionate builders and veteran founders. Our infrastructure makes stablecoins usable in the real-world by powering card transactions, cross-border payments, B2B purchases, remittances, and more. We partner with fintechs, neobanks, and institutions to help them launch solutions that are global, inclusive, and efficient. You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company that is funded by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS, including Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Lightspeed, Khosla, and several more. If you’re curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we’d love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Team

Rain is seeking a seasoned Account Manager to join our team, with a dedicated focus on our most strategic accounts. These relationships carry outsized revenue and reputational weight for Rain and require a high-touch, white-glove, deeply relationship-driven servicing model. In this role, you will be a key player in managing these top accounts end-to-end: driving expansions and renewals, leading QBRs, and ensuring Rain shows up as the best possible partner at every stage of the relationship. You will operate in a player-coach model, working closely alongside our existing senior and enterprise account managers.

What you’ll do

  • Embed directly into our most strategic accounts on day one

  • Own the senior relationship layer with key leaders across our partners and Rain

  • Unblock cross-functional issues fast by collaborate with internal teams to understand customer needs and tailor solutions to ensure needs are being exceeded

  • Drive revenue and deepen partnerships by identifying use-case expansion, upsell/cross-sell opportunities, and leading renewals, expansions, and QBRs end-to-end

  • Provide data-driven insights to enhance the user experience and ensure companies are making the most out of Rain's products

  • Set the enterprise account management operating rhythm: weekly account health reviews, escalation triage, and internal and third-party coordination on behalf of partners

  • Build the playbook for what dedicated enterprise servicing and relationship management looks like at Rain

  • Act as the primary advocate internally for our top accounts to make sure their needs shape how we prioritize and build

You are likely to succeed if you have:

  • 8+ years in account management, customer success, or strategic partnerships at a fintech, payments, or crypto company

  • A track record owning senior, executive-level client relationships, not just day-to-day account operations

  • Experience negotiating and managing complex commercial relationships involving legal, compliance, operational, technical, and executive stakeholders

  • Comfort operating without a large team on day one. This is a hands-on, embedded role for someone motivated by impact

  • Experience navigating escalations that require pulling in engineering, product, or compliance. You need to know how to get the right people in a room and hold them accountable

  • Senior roles at both large enterprises and startup or scale-up companies. Demonstrated ability to identify process improvements, build scalable solutions, and thrive in fast-moving, iterative environments

Bonus attributes:

  • Experience standing up a new team or function from scratch, rather than inheriting an existing one

  • Deep familiarity with stablecoins, cross-border payments infrastructure, and card issuing ecosystems

  • Existing network across fintech, banking, payments, stablecoin, or broader financial infrastructure ecosystems

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace, if you feel comfortable at home please work from home. If you’d like to work with others in an office feel free to come in. We want everyone to be able to work in the environment in which they are their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers will have a stipend to create a comfortable atmosphere at home.

Easy to access benefits 🧠For US Rainmakers, we offer comprehensive health, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents, as well as a 100% company subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 We offer every Rainmakers an equity option plan so we can all can benefit from our success.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers receive a monthly stipend to be used for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain! Time spent together helps us get to know each other, strengthen our relationships, and build a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites both domestically and internationally.

Definir la estrategia comercial global y la expansión del área, asumiendo la responsabilidad por sus resultados financieros. Monitorear el entorno competitivo y regulatorio, transformando esa información en iniciativas accionables. Liderazgo de equipos, diseñar y construir el equipo de Business Development (BizDev), liderar el equipo de Desarrollo Comercial y Corporativo. Asegurar que el equipo concrete las alianzas definidas y desarrolle nuevos negocios en las regiones estratégicas: Cono Sur, Brasil, México y Colombia. Medir el desempeño del equipo a través de acuerdos cerrados, volumen del pipeline comercial y nuevas alianzas. Desarrollo de negocios y alianzas, cerrar acuerdos complejos y de gran escala con instituciones, como grandes bancos, trabajando en conjunto con el CEO. Impulsar alianzas estratégicas e inversiones que amplíen la adopción de los productos de Ripio en casos de uso reales. Estructurar y negociar acuerdos comerciales y estratégicos, incluyendo listados de activos (listings), integraciones y soluciones de entrada y salida entre dinero fiat y cripto (on/off-ramps). Trabajar con el equipo de Alianzas Estratégicas para identificar potenciales clientes y socios por país, y posteriormente colaborar de manera directa con los equipos de BizDev y Sales. Aptos is a people-first blockchain on a mission to help billions of people achieve universal and fair access to decentralized assets in a safe and scalable way.

Founded by some of the original creators and maintainers that researched, designed, and built the Diem blockchain to serve this purpose, we have dedicated several years toward this mission. We believe the open-source Diem technology we have developed is an important foundation of a safe and scalable web3 world where everyone has more equitable opportunities to grow and access financial assets with lower fees and fewer intermediaries.  

Aptos (Ohlone for "The People") encompasses our mission and ethos for why we build.

About the Role

At Aptos Labs we’re pioneering the future of web3 and need a passionate Product Security Engineer to help secure our core technologies. In this role, you’ll be at the forefront of safeguarding our Aptos core infrastructure and Aptos Labs products. Your proactive approach will help us identify and mitigate emerging threats, ensuring our systems remain resilient and trustworthy. You will work closely with our developers, influence security best practices, and lead initiatives that shape the future of web3 security.

Responsibilities

  • Analyze and assess novel and recurring security issues via design reviews, code audits, and penetration tests.
  • Design and build security tools, and develop mitigations, frameworks, and hardening strategies tailored for vulnerability prevention and detection.
  • Review and develop secure operational practices, and provide security guidance for engineers.
  • Respond to and triage reports from bug bounty programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in vulnerability research and exploitation.
  • Experience with native development practices and common vulnerability patterns (e.g., Rust, C, etc.)
  • Experience with automated security analysis tooling and frameworks (fuzzing, static analysis, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Contributions to the security community (public research, blogging, talks in relevant conferences, etc.)
  • Experience with virtual machines or complex runtime environments, such as MoveVM (extra bonus), EVM, WASM, or LLVM-based runtimes, including their security models, sandboxing, and execution isolation.
  • Familiarity with smart contract programming languages (extra bonus for Move), security tools, and frameworks, including formal verification.

Our Benefits

  • 100% insurance premium coverage for medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents (US Employees)
  • Equipment of your choice
  • Flexible vacation time, 11 holidays, and floating company days off 
  • Competitive Salary
  • Protocol Token Grants
  • 401k matching (US Employees)
  • Fun and inclusive in-person and digital events

Aptos is committed to diversity in the workplace, and we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not hire on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, citizenship, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state or federal law. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

We are committed to providing a safe and secure hiring process for all applicants. Unfortunately, there are individuals who may attempt to impersonate Aptos or our employees for fraudulent purposes.To protect yourself, please be aware of the following:
  • We will never ask you for payment of any kind during the application or onboarding process, including fees for background checks, training, or equipment.
  • We will always communicate with you using our official company email domain.
  • We will never request your personal financial information, such as your social security number or bank account details, during the initial application stages or via email or a video/voice call when onboarding.

Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Human Resources Jobs • Web3 Remote Jobs • Web3 Full Time Jobs • Cryptocurrency Web3 Jobs

About ChainlinkChainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Since inventing decentralized oracle networks, Chainlink has enabled tens of trillions in transaction value and now secures the vast majority of DeFi.

Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

About The Role

Our People Business Partners are embedded in business teams and expected to do anything and everything to enable the success of those teams and their leaders. This means that our PBPs must have end-to-end mastery of all People disciplines, including employee relations, performance management, levelling and promotions, and compensation.

Our PBPs are truly expected to be the “Chief People Officer” for their teams. They are also, in addition, expected to gather deep anecdotal feedback from their teams and report that back up to the team leader and the Chief People Officer, to enable the Executive Leadership Team to address team member concerns more rapidly and with greater

The Chainlink PBP team follows a unique model - effectiveness and urgency.

Your Impact

  • Refining and guiding the development of People programs that are necessary for our success, such as levelling, promotions, performance management/cycles, etc.

  • Driving organizational strategies such as workforce planning, organizational design, and change management through a deep understanding of our business, market dynamics, and competitive landscape, to customize organizational structures and talent strategies that align Chainlink’s capabilities with business demands.

  • Collaborate with the other People Team members (People Operations & Technology, Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards) to influence and uplift the execution of People Team operations

Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience as a top-tier PBP in a similar PBP model

  • 2+ years of experience in a fast-paced and demanding technology company

  • Experience supporting engineering and/or Product orgs

  • Deep expertise with, curiosity about, and true vision for AI and how it is changing

  • A default orientation toward the following approaches/views of work:

    • A focus on business outputs and impact over anything else

    • An orientation toward data but a deep appreciation for actual on-the-ground anecdotes and experiences

    • Skepticism toward HR orthodoxy in every area

    • Analysis and logic over emotional appeals - but balanced by deep empathy and true care for all team members

All roles with Chainlink Labs are global and remote-based. Unless otherwise stated, we ask that you try to overlap some working hours with Eastern Standard Time (EST).

item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Analyst Jobs • Blockchain Compliance Jobs • Blockchain KYC Jobs • Cryptocurrency Full Time Jobs • Web3 Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Stablecoin Jobs

About us:

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

  • CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)
  • FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)
  • Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)
  • LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

About this role in the team:

Due to our expanding business, there is an increased demand for a Compliance Onboarding Analyst to join the Team. The role requires a high level of initiative, as well as expertise in a  FinTech environment and cooperation with corporate and individual clients. This role requires high attention to clients needs, self education and  self organization. This role will form part of our global team, and will work closely with Operations, Trading Team, Sales, and Management.

Key Areas of Responsibilities:

  • Manage the onboarding and due diligence process for the Company's Individual (Consumer) clients, ensuring adherence to best practices in KYC, compliance, and risk management.
  • Oversee the end-to-end Individual (Consumer) customer application process, including the collection, review, and verification of all required documentation.
  • Conduct Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), where required, in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Perform screening and due diligence checks, including Sanctions, Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), and Adverse Media screening, investigating and resolving any potential matches or alerts.
  • Conduct PEP risk assessments and make informed recommendations regarding escalations in accordance with internal policies and risk appetite.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, internal policies, and industry best practices throughout the customer onboarding lifecycle.
  • Make risk-based decisions on customer applications, determining when additional information, further investigation, or escalation is required, and follow through with appropriate actions.
  • Maintain accurate and complete customer records, ensuring all KYC documentation is up to date and audit-ready.
  • Identify and suggest improvements to onboarding processes to enhance efficiency, compliance, and customer experience.

What we need from you:

  • Fluent in English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimum 2 years' experience in KYC onboarding within the payments, fintech, banking, or foreign exchange (FX) industry.
  • Familiarity with customer onboarding requirements across multiple jurisdictions, particularly the EU and US.
  • Strong understanding of KYC, AML, Customer Due Diligence (CDD), and Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) requirements for individual customers.
  • Proven experience conducting customer screening, including Sanctions, Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), and Adverse Media checks, with the ability to assess results and manage escalations appropriately.
  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify potential risks, make sound risk-based decisions, and escalate complex cases where required.
  • Experience working within a regulated financial services environment and maintaining compliance with internal policies and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Hands-on experience using Sumsub or similar CRM/case management tools for customer onboarding and workflow management.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills, and the ability to manage multiple onboarding cases simultaneously while maintaining high standards of accuracy and compliance.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, managing competing priorities and meeting service level agreements (SLAs).

Nice to have:

  • Experience supporting Know Your Business (KYB) onboarding, including reviewing business documentation, identifying Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs), and understanding corporate ownership structures.

What you can expect from us:

  • Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth
  • Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart
  • A culture built on passionate growth minded people
  • A flexible approach to holiday
  • Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world, in locations such as London and Cape Town, to collaborate with your colleagues 
  • An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, it’s culture, and it’s opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.

About ChainlinkChainlink is the industry-standard oracle platform bringing the capital markets onchain and powering the majority of decentralized finance (DeFi). The Chainlink stack provides the essential data, interoperability, compliance, and privacy standards needed to power advanced blockchain use cases for institutional tokenized assets, lending, payments, stablecoins, and more. Many of the world’s largest financial services institutions have also adopted Chainlink’s standards and infrastructure, including Swift, Euroclear, Mastercard, Fidelity International, UBS, S&P Dow Jones Indices, FTSE Russell, WisdomTree, ANZ, and top protocols such as Aave, Lido, GMX and many others. Chainlink leverages a novel fee model where offchain and onchain revenue from enterprise adoption is converted to LINK tokens and stored in a strategic Chainlink Reserve. Learn more at chain.link.

About the Role

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer will own the reliability and operational performance of large-scale distributed systems and data infrastructure. This role will strengthen the production operation of streaming and Kubernetes workloads while ensuring infrastructure changes are managed through repeatable, version-controlled practices. The role will also improve the scalability and operational efficiency of the infrastructure that engineering teams depend on.

Your Impact

  • Enable critical product initiatives to launch on time. Deliver the streaming and data infrastructure required by CRE, CCIP, Data Feeds and Data Streams, translating product requirements into reliable Redpanda/Kafka and Flink capabilities.

  • Maintain 99.9% availability for critical data infrastructure as usage grows. Scale streaming and Kubernetes workloads, resolve throughput and recovery bottlenecks, and define SLIs that reflect the experience of consuming services.

  • Keep operational maintenance below 20% of team capacity. Reduce recurring incidents, manual interventions and routine maintenance through automation, actionable alerts, tested recovery procedures and repeatable vulnerability remediation.

  • Reduce cost to serve and make consumption accountable. Connect Redpanda topic traffic, Flink processing and BigQuery usage to the teams and services consuming them.

  • Increase infrastructure self-service and operational safety. Establish reusable infrastructure modules, deployment workflows and documentation that enable engineering teams to provision, test, scale and retire AWS and Kubernetes resources independently.

  • Use service adoption and consumer needs to guide infrastructure improvements. Establish visibility into infrastructure consumers, service adoption, reliability, cost and maintenance effort.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience operating large-scale distributed systems and scalable data processing infrastructure in production, including managing availability, consistency, failure modes and performance trade-offs.

  • Operated Kafka or Kafka-compatible streaming platforms such as Redpanda in production, with hands-on experience in capacity planning, performance tuning and troubleshooting.

  • Provisioned and managed production infrastructure using Terraform, with version-controlled, reviewed and repeatable infrastructure changes.

  • Experience deploying, operating and troubleshooting production Kubernetes workloads, including resource management, scaling and safe rollouts.

Preferred Requirements

  • Built reusable infrastructure modules, self-service capabilities and CI/CD workflows that enable engineering teams to deploy and operate services independently.

  • Experience building and operating Apache Flink pipelines in production, including monitoring, diagnosing failures and managing recovery.

  • Operated AWS Aurora/RDS in production, including provisioning, backup and recovery, failover, rightsizing and cost optimization.

  • Advanced experience with 1 or more of Apache Flink, Redpanda/Kafka, Iceberg, PostgreSQL, Airflow or Trino, demonstrated through work with system internals, complex troubleshooting or performance optimization.

  • Experience reading, debugging and writing production-quality code in Java and/or Go.

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure or data projects through code, tooling, documentation or actionable bug reports.

item.title: Founding Payments Engineer - Backend & Blockchain
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Developer Jobs • Cryptocurrency Backend Jobs • Blockchain Remote Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Product: Ihsan Pay

Website:https://ihsan.com/

SocialMedia:https://www.instagram.com/sultansamuelaziz/

YouTube:https://www.youtube.com/@sultansamuelaziz/

Stack: Go, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, React Native, Solana

About Ihsan Pay

Ihsan Pay is building a self-custodial stablecoin payment system that feels as simple and familiar as a modern bank account.

It will be integrated into the Ihsan messenger and enable users to:

  • Hold USDC and EURC stablecoins as well as PAXG in self-custodial wallets
  • Pay and receive money through QR codes and user-to-user payments
  • Accept payments as a local or online merchant
  • On- and off-ramp from and to Fiat Accounts
  • Spend via a stablecoin-connected Visa debit card

Our goal is to hide the complexity of wallets, blockchain addresses, seed phrases and network fees while allowing users to retain control over their money.

The role

We are looking for a senior or staff payments engineer to become one of the founding technical developers of Ihsan Pay.

You will design and build the first version of our payment infrastructure, working closely with our existing development team.

This is not primarily a token, NFT or DeFi role. We are building reliable consumer payment infrastructure where security, accuracy and usability are essential.

What you will build

  • Embedded self-custodial wallets using Privy
  • Stablecoin transfers on Solana
  • Username and phone-number-to-wallet resolution
  • Money transfers inside messenger conversations
  • Personal and merchant QR payments
  • Payment requests, receipts and transaction history
  • Sponsored network fees and gas abstraction
  • Blockchain monitoring and transaction reconciliation
  • Merchant payment APIs, webhooks and checkout infrastructure
  • On/off-ramp integrations with providers such as Bridge
  • Card integration with infrastructure providers such as Rain
  • Secure wallet recovery and key-export flows

Your responsibilities

  • Build secure and scalable backend payment services
  • Integrate wallet, blockchain, KYC, on-ramp and card providers
  • Ensure Ihsan Pay cannot independently access users’ self-custodial funds
  • Build a financial ledger
  • Design reliable transaction-status and reconciliation systems
  • Establish security standards and review payment-related code

What we are looking for

  • Experience in fintech or stablecoin payments
  • Experience building or integrating blockchain wallets and transactions
  • Experience with payment APIs, webhooks, idempotency and reconciliation
  • Strong understanding of private-key security, transaction signing and wallet recovery
  • Ability to make architectural decisions
  • Clear communication and strong technical documentation
  • A security-first approach to financial infrastructure

Strong advantages

  • Experience building financial ledgers
  • Experience with Privy, Persona, Rain, Bridge
  • Experience with stablecoin payment products
  • Experience with Solana
  • Experience with Go, TypeScript or a comparable language
  • Experience integrating on/off-ramps, card issuers or payment processors
  • Experience with QR payments or merchant checkout systems
  • Experience building consumer fintech, wallets, remittance or neobanking products
  • Experience taking a payment product from prototype to production

Who this role is not for

This role is unlikely to be suitable if your blockchain experience consists primarily of:

  • Creating tokens
  • NFT projects
  • Trading bots
  • Experimental smart contracts
  • DeFi projects without production payment experience

We need someone who understands both blockchain technology and the reliability requirements of real financial systems.

Why join

  • Help building a payment system for the global Ummah
  • Take technical ownership of a new payment system from its foundation
  • Build a product designed for meaningful global use
  • Shape the architecture instead of inheriting legacy infrastructure
  • Work on the intersection of stablecoins, messaging and everyday payments
  • Competitive compensation and meaningful long-term equity participation

How to apply

We are a highly mission and vision driven StartUp.

Before you apply, please have a quick look at our social media to make sure you align with our values and mission.

To apply, please send an email to vincent@ ihsan.com.

What we would like you to include in your application:

  • Short personal message that describes why you would like to join our team.
  • Links to projects you worked on that were similar to what we are building.
  • Your CV
  • LinkedIn Profile
Apply here 👉 Founding Payments Engineer - Backend & Blockchain

item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Cryptocurrency Engineering Manager Jobs • Blockchain DevOps Jobs • Blockchain Kubernetes Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs • Web3 Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Stablecoin Jobs

BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This role will require being full-time onsite at our New York City or Toronto office to support collaborative team dynamics and innovative problem-solving. You will participate in an on-call rotation covering 8:00am–4:00pm ET.

This is a player-coach role: you'll lead a small team of infrastructure engineers while staying hands-on in the engineering work itself. You'll be an extra set of hands on your team's projects, take on smaller initiatives yourself so the team can stay focused on roadmap work, and help build, shape, and execute our infrastructure roadmap. Expect to spend roughly 60% of your time on hands-on engineering and 40% on leading the team.

What you'll do

Lead the team

  • Lead and develop a small team of talented infrastructure engineers through regular 1:1s, coaching, feedback, and career development
  • Help shape a team culture of open communication, craftsmanship, and ownership
  • Take direct responsibility for the quality and delivery of the team's work
  • Participate in hiring and growing the team
  • Protect the team's focus by triaging incoming requests and unplanned work, so engineers can stay on roadmap priorities

Stay hands-on

  • Be an extra set of hands on your team's projects: pair on hard problems, unblock work, review designs and code, and pick up pieces of larger efforts when it helps the team move faster
  • Own and deliver smaller infrastructure initiatives end to end
  • Participate in the team's on-call rotation (8:00am–4:00pm ET), act as a technical leader during production incidents, and drive postmortems and follow-up work
  • Champion Infrastructure as Code, automation, and engineering best practices, leading by example

Shape the roadmap

  • Partner with the Head of Infrastructure to build, shape, and execute the infrastructure roadmap
  • Translate long-term goals into concrete, shippable milestones, and plan, estimate, and make tradeoffs with your team
  • Own and be accountable for KPIs covering the reliability, resiliency, and uptime of critical services
  • Collaborate with engineering, security, and product teams to identify infrastructure requirements, risks, and opportunities, including cloud cost optimization
  • Facilitate thorough documentation and knowledge sharing

What we're looking for

We are looking for teammates who share and practice our values: open communication, transparency, taking ownership, and a high level of craftsmanship.

Required

  • 6+ years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering, building and operating complex, high-stakes production systems
  • 2+ years leading a team of engineers, including people leadership responsibilities such as 1:1s, feedback, and performance conversations
  • A track record of balancing hands-on technical work with team leadership
  • Extensive experience securing, scaling, and operating Kubernetes in production, with associated tooling (ArgoCD, GitOps, Grafana) and advanced Terraform
  • Hands-on experience with a major public cloud provider. We operate primarily on AWS but believe skills in one cloud provider translate to others
  • Strong Linux systems administration skills and networking fundamentals (VPCs, security groups, load balancers, CNI plugins, network policy management)
  • Proficiency in at least one high-level programming language, preferably Go, with strong bash scripting
  • Operational experience with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience participating in and organizing on-call rotations, and leading incident response
  • Strong project management skills and experience collaborating across teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred

  • Security operations experience, including vulnerability management, security monitoring, and incident response
  • Experience with compliance frameworks and audit lifecycles (SOC, ISO, regulators, etc.)
  • Cloud cost optimization and capacity planning experience
  • Deep observability experience (Prometheus, Alertmanager, Loki, ELK)
  • Experience sourcing and hiring engineering talent
  • A history of delivering internal tools or automation that improved developer or operator workflows
  • Blockchain/crypto infrastructure experience, such as running nodes and validators
  • Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries

Why Join BitGo?

Disrupting an industry takes vision, innovation, passion, technical chops, drive to deliver, collaboration, and execution. Join a team of great people who strive for excellence and personify our corporate values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. We are looking for new colleagues who bring innovative ways of thinking and problem-solving, and who want risks to be part of the team that changes the world’s financial markets.

  • Competitive base salary, bonus, and stock options
  • 100% company-paid health insurance for employee, partner, and dependents
  • Up to 4% 401k company match
  • Paid parental leave, Paid vacation
  • Free commuter/parking pass
  • Free custom lunches and snacks
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and an inspiring environment

Benefits may vary based on location.

Pay Transparency Notice:

Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $220,000 and $280,000 USD base salary. Equity, an annual performance bonus, and the benefits outlined above are also part of this role’s package.

item.title: Marketing Generalist, BitGo Labs (Contract)
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Blockchain Marketing Jobs • Web3 Seo Jobs • Cryptocurrency Social Media Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs • Web3 Web3 Jobs • Web3 Stablecoin Jobs

BitGo (NYSE: BTGO) is the digital asset infrastructure company delivering custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement services from regulated cold storage. Since 2013, BitGo has focused on accelerating the transition of the financial system to a digital asset economy. BitGo maintains a global presence and multiple regulated entities, including BitGo Bank & Trust, National Association, the first federally chartered digital asset trust bank owned by a publicly traded company. Today, BitGo serves thousands of institutions, including many of the industry's top brands, financial institutions, exchanges, and platforms, and millions of investors worldwide. For more information, visit www.bitgo.com.

This is a Contractor position. Based in Palo Alto,CA - Onsite 

BitGo spent a decade building the infrastructure the digital asset industry runs on. Custody, settlement, wallets, a national trust bank charter. Rails that institutions trust with hundreds of billions of dollars.

Custody is the operating system. BitGo Labs builds the apps.

We are looking for a marketing Generalist who wants to take more real products to market in one term than most marketers launch in years.

What BitGo Labs is

Most corporate innovation labs are where ideas go to be studied. Decks get made. Pilots get piloted. Nothing ever meets a customer.

We built Labs to be the opposite of that. We push out real, live, revenue-generating products, and every one has to clear the same two-part bar:

  • A value proposition or economics only possible because of crypto. If a normal company could build it on normal rails, it fails the test.
  • Only buildable this fast because of AI. Three months from blank page to live product. Not a prototype, not a beta behind a waitlist. Live.

Some of these products will become businesses. Some will be shut down on schedule, without ceremony, because the numbers said so. Both outcomes are the system working.

What You'll Do:

You’ll sit right next to the product and engineering teams, working to put these 90-day products into the hands of real users.

A cycle looks like this:

  • Pre-GTM Strategy: Take a product thesis and figure out who the first user is. Define the wedge, the messaging, and the distribution channels before the code is even finished.
  • Demand Generation & SEO: Build the engine that gets eyes on the product. Use AI to spin up optimized landing pages, test copy, and hack organic growth in days, not months.
  • Social Media & Community: Be the voice of our new launches. You'll own the social media strategy to build hype, tap into crypto culture, and directly engage with our early adopters.
  • Post-GTM & User Adoption: Read the results honestly. Look at the analytics, track user adoption, and figure out what’s actually converting versus what's just noise.
  • Iterate or Kill It: Set the bar before launch. Real numbers, committed in advance, that decide a campaign's fate. If a channel isn't hitting the numbers, you kill it and start the next one without a mourning period.

You will not be handed a generic marketing playbook. You'll be handed products, a budget, and a deadline.

Who Would Be a Great Fit:

  • Someone who has marketed something from nothing. A side hustle, a startup, a newsletter, or a personal brand. "I scheduled tweets for an existing brand" is a different job.
  • Professional experience in Marketing, Growth, Communications, or a related field, with a proven track record of driving user acquisition and engagement.
  • Someone who builds. You prototype with AI tools, wire up your own landing pages, generate your own copy, and run your own analytics. The era of the marketer who can only write briefs for an agency is over, and you're glad.
  • Someone comfortable with crypto, or unafraid of getting there fast. You understand internet culture, crypto Twitter (X), and what makes people actually click.
  • Someone who decides. Small team, short cycles, no committee coming to save you.
  • Someone who can kill their own work. Shut down the campaign, take the learning, and start the next one without a mourning period. We screen for this.

The honest part

This role has no stable roadmap, no massive marketing agency support, and no tidy org chart. Some of the products you market will be shut down, and your campaigns along with them. If you want a sleepy corporate job analyzing a single ad campaign for months, this is the wrong job, and we'd rather you know now.

But if you’ve ever looked at a massive company’s resources and thought about the massive growth you could drive if someone just let you run fast—this is the job where someone lets you.

Why Join BitGo?

Revolutionizing finance requires vision, innovation, and execution. Join a team of world-class professionals who embody our values of ownership, craftsmanship, and open communication. At BitGo, we are building the infrastructure that secures the future of digital assets.

We offer:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Free custom lunches, dinners, and snacks
  • Computer equipment and workplace furniture to suit your needs
  • Great colleagues and inspiring startup environment

Pay Transparency Notice: Depending upon your leveling and location, the compensation for this role averages between $10,000 -13,000 per month.

Apply here 👉 Marketing Generalist, BitGo Labs (Contract)

item.title: Senior Video Creative, Performance - Kraken Consumer
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Web3 Senior Jobs • Web3 Copywriter Jobs • Web3 Marketing Jobs • Cryptocurrency Remote Jobs • Cryptocurrency Full Time Jobs • Blockchain Web3 Jobs

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

  • Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

  • Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

  • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

  • Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

  • Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

  • High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

  • Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

  • A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

item.title: Customer Support Specialist (APAC)
item.description:
Tags: Web3 Jobs • Cryptocurrency Customer Support Jobs • Cryptocurrency Remote Jobs • Blockchain Full Time Jobs

About us

Relay is a cross-chain payments protocol that provides instant, low-cost cross-chain bridging, swaps, and transactions. We're the fastest and cheapest way to bridge and transact across chains, serving over 5 million users who have completed 59+ million transactions with $6+ billion in volume across 85+ chains.

Our company mission is to make transacting across chains as fast, cheap, and reliable as online payments. We are building the core infrastructure to abstract chains from end user payments, enabling the next billion users to experience the benefits of blockchain without the UX burdens.

About the role

Relay's integrator base has roughly doubled in the last six months, and we're looking for Customer Support Specialists to help triage tickets, investigate issues, answer questions, and turn everyday support work into better systems for our customers and our team.

What you'll do

Own front-line support in specific time zone hours

  • Provide reliable overlap with our existing support team for incoming customer issues during your time zone working hours. We're currently looking for:
  • Specialists who are in UTC 5 through UTC+9:30 timezones in APAC (Asia Pacific, including East Asia, South Asia, Southeast Asia, and Oceania). This role includes weekend coverage and will be a Saturday to Wednesday schedule.

Triage and debug customer issues

  • Respond to customer tickets with clarity and care, handling the ones you can resolve directly
  • Investigate issues using Relay's backend logs, transaction records, and block explorers
  • Build fluency with on-chain transaction flows for end users and integrators
  • Escalate the right issues to engineering with enough context for them to move quickly
  • Take on an increasing share of ticket volume and ownership so the team's capacity keeps pace with integrator growth

Translate support work into better systems

  • Turn recurring customer issues into process improvements, internal documentation, and feedback for product and engineering
  • Communicate technical context at the right level for customers and internal stakeholders
  • Contribute to long-term project work such as automation, documentation, and self-serve tooling in the developer portal
  • Build depth over time on Relay's protocol, integrations, and customer base

About you

  • You're a clear, calm communicator with customers and internal stakeholders
  • You have high agency: you take ownership, drive issues to resolution, and don't wait to be told what to do
  • You're already using LLMs as part of your daily workflow and are quick to pick up new tools and technology
  • You can scale complex explanations to different audiences
  • You treat support work as a system: every ticket is a signal, not just something to close
  • You're excited about blockchain and excited to go deep on the crypto side (block explorers, logs, on-chain flows)
  • You work well in a fast-moving startup environment and have contributed to shaping structure and processes
  • You have a keen eye for detail and notice the little things

Skills and abilities

Must-have

  • 3+ years of customer or technical support experience in the tech industry
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong computer and software tooling fluency, including everyday use of AI tools
  • Experience triaging competing priorities in real time
  • A track record of turning recurring support issues into systems or process improvements

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with crypto or blockchain concepts, block explorers, logs, or on-chain transaction flows
  • Experience supporting developers or API integrators
  • Prior support experience at an early-stage or fast-growing startup
  • Exposure to developer tooling, self-serve product work, or internal automation

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary
  • Equity package
  • Comprehensive health benefits
  • Unlimited PTO policy with encouraged minimum
  • Remote-first culture with emphasis on collaboration, communication, and flexibility
Apply here 👉 Customer Support Specialist (APAC)
